strings.Pensa a PROFINET come alla normale rete: Think of PROFINET as the normal office Ethernet network, but with a reserved lane for machine data. The PLC (IO-Controller) knows each device by name and, at regular intervals, sends commands and receives status.
strings.Per i compiti normali (leggere sensori,: For normal tasks (reading sensors, driving valves) RT mode is enough. When synchronized movements are needed, as in a multi-axis robot, you switch to IRT, which reserves ‘time windows’ and guarantees punctuality.
strings.PROFINET in pratica: il controller stabi: PROFINET in practice: the controller establishes an Application Relation (AR) with each device via RPC over UDP; then the cyclic data travel in RT frames directly on layer 2 (EtherType 0x8892) with VLAN priority 6. The watchdog (DataHoldFactor × cycle) signals the loss of a provider.
strings.Per il motion si usa IRT con scheduling: For motion, IRT is used with TDMA scheduling and synchronized clock (PTCP): the reserved window prevents TCP/IP traffic from interfering with the cyclic frames. Diagnostics through alarms, LLDP/SNMP for topology, DCP to assign names and IPs.
strings.Esempio: una linea di assemblaggio auto: Example: a car assembly line with a Siemens PLC, 80 I/O modules in the cabinet and 12 drives. They are connected in star and line with ordinary Ethernet cables; the network is configured in TIA Portal by assigning each module a name (e.g. 'conveyor-input-1'). If a cable breaks, an MRP ring restarts communication within a few hundred milliseconds.
strings.Esempio: 12 azionamenti in IRT a 1 ms co: Example: 12 drives in IRT at 1 ms with a line topology. The engineering defines the node order and the IRT window; when a device is replaced, the controller recognizes it by name and neighbours (LLDP) without reprogramming it.
strings.I dispositivi inviano i dati da soli a r: The devices send data on their own at a fixed pace and warn with alarms; a parameter can also be requested.

Yes: the cycle time is predictable.
strings.Deterministico: il ciclo è calcolabile d: Deterministic: the cycle can be calculated from the baud rate, number of slaves and data length. DP-V2 offers isochronism (Isochronous Mode).
strings.≈ 1–10 ms tipico a 12 Mbit/s; dipende da: ≈ 1–10 ms typical at 12 Mbit/s; depends on the number of slaves, I/O bytes and baud rate (calculation with PI tools).

strings.I limiti di lunghezza dipendono dal tipo: Length limits depend on the cable type and baud rate; the quoted values apply to type A cable.
strings.PROFIBUS è un bus 'vecchia scuola' ma af: PROFIBUS is an ‘old school’ but reliable bus: a single two-wire cable runs through the plant and all devices are connected in parallel, like the bulbs of a string of lights.
strings.Funziona a turni: il master chiede a ogn: It works in turns: the master asks each slave ‘give me your inputs and take your outputs’ and moves on to the next. Since the turns are ordered, the time of a complete round is predictable.
strings.PROFIBUS DP usa RS-485 con caratteri UAR: PROFIBUS DP uses RS-485 with 11-bit UART characters (start, 8 data, even parity, stop). Medium access is hybrid: token between masters and master→slave polling. The cycle is about Σ(Tframe request + TSDR + Tframe response + Tidle) over all slaves.
strings.Setup tipico: Set_Prm, Chk_Cfg, Slave_Di: Typical setup: Set_Prm, Chk_Cfg, Slave_Diag until ‘ready’, then cyclic Data_Exchange; DP-V1 adds acyclic services and alarms, DP-V2 isochronism and slave-to-slave. In field problems, terminations, shielding, length and baud rate matter.
strings.Esempio: in un vecchio impianto di imbal: Example: in an old packaging plant with 30 I/O modules over 200 m, the purple PROFIBUS cable is already laid. If the PLC is replaced, it is often best to keep the bus: it costs less than rewiring. Careful: termination at both ends is needed, otherwise random errors appear.
strings.Esempio: 12 Mbit/s con 10 slave da 4 byt: Example: 12 Mbit/s with 10 slaves of 4 I/O bytes: the cycle is of the order of 1–2 ms. At 500 kbit/s with 30 slaves it rises to over 10 ms; so, with many slaves, the speed is lowered only if the length requires it (≈ 400 m at 500 kbit/s).
The master polls each slave in turn.
strings.Polling ciclico master→slave (Data_Excha: Cyclic master→slave polling (Data_Exchange) with a calculable cycle; DP-V1 adds alarms but always within the cycle.

strings.Latenza tipica 5–50 ms per richiesta, di: Typical latency 5–50 ms per request, depends on the CPU, negotiated PDU size (e.g. 240/480/960 B) and load.
strings.Sicurezza limitata nel S7comm classico;: Limited security in classic S7comm; S7CommPlus (S7-1200/1500) adds integrity

strings.Il comportamento di S7-1200/1500 dipende: The behaviour of S7-1200/1500 depends on firmware and protection settings (PUT/GET access, password, S7CommPlus). Specification obtained through reverse engineering, not official.
strings.S7comm è come telefonare al PLC Siemens: S7comm is like phoning the Siemens PLC to ask it a question: ‘what is the piece counter value?’ and the PLC answers. There is no fixed exchange schedule: you ask when needed.
strings.Per questo è perfetto per supervisione,: That is why it is perfect for supervision, diagnostics and programming tools, but not for driving a motor in real time.
strings.S7comm viaggia su TCP/102 con TPKT e COT: S7comm runs on TCP/102 with TPKT and COTP (RFC 1006). After the TCP handshake and COTP CR/CC the PDU is negotiated with Setup Communication (0xF0), then Read Var (0x04) and Write Var (0x05) are used with S7ANY items (area, DB, offset).
strings.La specifica è nota da reverse engineeri: The specification is known through reverse engineering (libraries such as Snap7). On modern S7-1200/1500, S7CommPlus or OPC UA is preferable, because classic S7comm lacks robust authentication.
strings.Esempio: un PC in sala controllo legge o: Example: a PC in the control room reads the number of pieces produced every second from a DB of an S7-1500 and shows it on a dashboard. For access to work, ‘PUT/GET’ must be enabled in the CPU, which reduces protection: it should only be done on protected networks.
strings.Esempio: lettura di DB1.DBD0 (REAL): ite: Example: reading DB1.DBD0 (REAL): item with area 0x84, DB=1, bit address 0, length 4 B. With a PDU negotiated at 480 bytes, several items can be read per request, reducing the number of round trips.
strings.Il client chiede e il PLC risponde; ness: The client asks and the PLC answers; no spontaneous notices.
strings.Read Var/Write Var su richiesta; nessuna: Read Var/Write Var on request; no on-change notification from the client (polling only).
strings.Un 'treno' di dati che attraversa tutti: A ‘train’ of data crossing all devices very quickly.
strings.Ethernet real-time con elaborazione on-t: Real-time Ethernet with on-the-fly processing (ETG, IEC 61158 type 12), a single frame per cycle crossing the logical ring.
strings.Un treno che passa in ogni stazione senz: A train that passes through every station without stopping: each station loads and unloads its parcels while the train keeps moving.
strings.Controllare molti I/O e assi con cicli v: Control many I/Os and axes with very fast, synchronized cycles.
strings.Scambio di dati di processo ad alte pres: High-performance process-data exchange, synchronization with Distributed Clocks, mailbox (CoE, FoE, EoE) for acyclic services.
strings.Cavo Ethernet o speciale bus interno per: Ethernet cable or a special internal bus for the modules.
strings.100BASE-TX/FX, E-Bus (LVDS) nei morsetti: 100BASE-TX/FX, E-Bus (LVDS) in Beckhoff terminals; EtherCAT G/G10 for 1 and 10 Gbit/s (introduced in recent years).
strings.Fisicamente linea, albero o stella (con: Physically line, tree or star (with junctions); logically a ring: the frame returns to the master. Cable redundancy with a second master port.
strings.Master/slave: solo il master genera fram: Master/slave: only the master generates frames; slaves with ESC read/write ‘on the fly’ (per-node delay ~ hundreds of ns). Working Counter (WKC) for validation.
strings.Hard real-time: ciclo fisso, Distributed: Hard real-time: fixed cycle, Distributed Clocks with jitter ≪ 1 µs (typically < 100 ns).
strings.Da ~31,25 µs (pochi nodi) a 1 ms e oltre: From ~31.25 µs (few nodes) to 1 ms and beyond; e.g. 1000 digital I/Os in ~30 µs. Depends on data per slave and the master.
strings.Cicli estremi richiedono un master ottim: Extreme cycles require an optimized master
strings.Non è instradabile oltre il segmento L2: Not routable beyond the L2 segment without a gateway
strings.Tempi ciclo minimi realistici dipendono: Realistic minimum cycle times depend on the master CPU, the driver (kernel/real-time) and the amount of data.
strings.Immagina un treno che parte dal PLC e pa: Imagine a train that leaves the PLC and passes through every station without stopping: at each station an operator unloads the parcel meant for them and loads what they want to ship while the train moves on. At the end the train comes back with everything. That is EtherCAT.
strings.Poiché il treno è uno solo per tutti, la: Since there is only one train for everyone, the network uses very little time and allows cycles of fractions of a millisecond, with perfectly synchronized axes.
strings.Il master trasmette un frame con uno o p: The master transmits a frame with one or more datagrams (EtherType 0x88A4). Each ESC (slave controller) reads and writes the data on the fly with a delay of hundreds of ns and increments the Working Counter. The last slave detects the free port and sends the frame back towards the master.
strings.La sincronizzazione usa Distributed Cloc: Synchronization uses Distributed Clocks: the first slave with DC is the reference; the master measures propagation delays and compensates offsets, obtaining jitter ≪ 1 µs. The cycle is limited by data per slave, master CPU and driver.
strings.Esempio: una macchina CNC con 8 assi, 2: Example: a CNC machine with 8 axes, 2 spindles and 200 digital I/Os. A single daisy-chain cable leaves the industrial PC and crosses all modules; the cycle is 250 µs. The modules need no switch: each module has two ports and passes the frame to the next.
strings.Esempio: 3 slave da 8 byte: il frame res: Example: 3 slaves of 8 bytes: the frame stays at the Ethernet minimum (64 bytes) and occupies the medium for about 7 µs at 100 Mbit/s, plus node delays; so cycles of 50–100 µs are realistic with an optimized master.
strings.Il master manda un 'treno' di dati a ogn: The master sends a ‘train’ of data every cycle and collects the replies.
strings.Ciclico guidato dal master (LRW su frame: Cyclic driven by the master (LRW on a passing frame); events (EMCY, AL) via mailbox or interrupt, in practice exceptions.
strings.Il protocollo con cui Beckhoff/TwinCAT s: The protocol Beckhoff/TwinCAT uses to exchange data between programs and PLCs.

No: not designed for real time.

strings.ADS è il modo in cui programmi e PLC Bec: ADS is the way Beckhoff programs and PLCs talk to each other. Each program has an ‘extension’ (port) and a ‘prefix’ (NetId), like a company switchboard.
strings.La particolarità è la notifica: invece d: The special feature is notification: instead of asking every second ‘has anything changed?’, you tell the PLC ‘notify me when the temperature changes’ and it sends you a message only in that case.
strings.ADS incapsula i comandi in AMS (TCP 4889: ADS encapsulates commands in AMS (TCP 48898): AMS header with Target/Source NetId and port, Command ID, Invoke ID to correlate replies. For a symbol you do a ReadWrite on IndexGroup 0xF003 (GetSymHandleByName) and then Read/Write or Add Device Notification on the handle.
strings.Le route ADS vanno configurate nei route: ADS routes must be configured in the AMS routers; in exposed environments ADS Secure (TLS) or ADS-over-MQTT is preferred. Typical errors: 0x6 (target port not found), 0x7 (target machine not found) for missing routes.
strings.Esempio: una dashboard su PC mostra lo s: Example: a PC dashboard shows the state of a TwinCAT press. With ADS notifications the dashboard updates only when the value changes, reducing network traffic and PLC load compared with continuous polling.
strings.Esempio: Add Device Notification in moda: Example: Add Device Notification in OnChange mode with MaxDelay 100 ms: if the variable changes ten times in 100 ms, the PLC sends a single grouped notification frame with all the samples and timestamps.

strings.Protocollo publish/subscribe OASIS (ISO/: OASIS publish/subscribe protocol (ISO/IEC 20922) over TCP with a central broker, QoS 0/1/2.
strings.Come un gruppo di notizie: il sensore pu: Like a newsgroup: the sensor publishes a message on a topic, the ‘postman’ (broker) delivers it to all subscribers.
strings.Portare dati da molti sensori a molte ap: Bring data from many sensors to many applications, even over the Internet.
strings.Telemetria e IIoT con disaccoppiamento t: Telemetry and IIoT with decoupling between producers and consumers; with Sparkplug B, topics and payloads for industry are defined.

strings.Non a ciclo: i messaggi partono quando s: Not cyclic: messages are sent when needed.
strings.Event-driven; latenze tipiche da pochi m: Event-driven; typical latencies from a few ms to seconds depending on network and broker; configurable keep-alive.
strings.Ideale per reti instabili e collegamenti: Ideal for unstable networks and slow links

strings.MQTT v5 aggiunge reason code, user prope: MQTT v5 adds reason codes, user properties, shared subscriptions; not all brokers/clients support them.
strings.MQTT è come un gruppo di notizie: il sen: MQTT is like a newsgroup: the sensor writes ‘temperature = 23.4’ on a topic and the broker delivers it to everyone subscribed to that topic. The writer does not know who reads, and vice versa.
strings.È leggerissimo e tollera le connessioni: It is extremely light and tolerates slow or unstable connections, so it is ideal for bringing data from the factory to the cloud.
strings.MQTT usa pacchetti con header fisso di 2: MQTT uses packets with a fixed header of 2–5 bytes (type+flags, variable-length Remaining Length). The QoS levels are: 0 (at most once), 1 (at least once, PUBACK), 2 (exactly once, PUBREC/PUBREL/PUBCOMP). With retain the broker stores the last value for new subscribers.
strings.In ambito industriale si usa Sparkplug B: In industrial settings Sparkplug B is used (topics spBv1.0/…, Protobuf payload): it defines birth/death of nodes (NBIRTH/NDEATH) and metrics. The broker must be sized and made redundant: it is the central point.
strings.Esempio: 200 sensori di umidità in una s: Example: 200 humidity sensors in a greenhouse publish on 'greenhouse1/zone3/humidity'. A dashboard subscribes to 'greenhouse1/#' to see everything, while an alarm subscribes only to 'greenhouse1/+/humidity'. If a sensor suddenly switches off, the broker publishes its ‘Last Will’ message and the alarm triggers.
strings.Esempio: un gateway con QoS 1 invia 'pla: Example: a gateway with QoS 1 sends 'plant/line1/temp' every 5 s. If the network drops, the client keeps the session and retransmits unconfirmed messages; with QoS 0 those messages would be lost.
strings.Chi pubblica invia solo quando c'è una n: Whoever publishes sends only when there is news; subscribers receive it.
strings.Il 'linguaggio universale' dell'industri: The ‘universal language’ of industry: data with meaning, secure and manufacturer-independent.
strings.IEC 62541: architettura service-oriented: IEC 62541: service-oriented architecture with information model, built-in security, client/server and PubSub (Part 14).
strings.Come un catalogo ordinato con etichette:: Like an orderly catalogue with labels: not just the value, but also what it is, in which unit and who may read it.
strings.Scambiare dati industriali in modo stand: Exchange industrial data in a standard and secure way between machines, PLCs and IT software.
strings.Interoperabilità semantica tramite addre: Semantic interoperability through address space, nodes, types and companion specifications (PackML, Euromap, umati, PROFINET, …).
strings.Ethernet, Wi-Fi, cellulare; con PubSub+T: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, cellular; with PubSub+TSN over L2 Ethernet for real-time applications.

strings.Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep, A: Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep, Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss; None not recommended. The Basic128Rsa15/Basic256 policies are deprecated
strings.Le security policy supportate e le funzi: The supported security policies and features (PubSub, TSN, Safety) depend on the stack, specification version and device profile.
strings.OPC UA non trasporta solo numeri: descri: OPC UA does not carry only numbers: it describes what they are. Instead of ‘DB10.DBD4 = 23.4’ you see ‘Boiler temperature, 23.4 °C, last updated at 10:02’. It is an orderly catalogue any software understands.
strings.Inoltre è sicuro per costruzione: client: It is also secure by design: client and server exchange certificates and can encrypt everything. It is the standard designed to make machines from different manufacturers talk to IT systems.
strings.Sessione client/server tipica: HEL/ACK,: Typical client/server session: HEL/ACK, OpenSecureChannel (security policy and mode), CreateSession, ActivateSession (user identity), CreateSubscription with MonitoredItem and Publish. Data are nodes (NodeId) with attributes (Value, DataType, timestamp, StatusCode).
strings.Oltre al client/server esiste PubSub (Pa: Besides client/server there is PubSub (Part 14) with UDP, MQTT, AMQP or Ethernet UADP transport. Companion Specifications (e.g. PackML, Euromap, umati) standardize models by machine type. Always check the supported security policies and certificates.
strings.Esempio: una fabbrica ha macchine di tre: Example: a factory has machines from three brands. The MES connects to all of them with a single OPC UA client and browses the data tree: Machine > State > Piece counter, without knowing the internal registers of each.
strings.Esempio: subscription con publishing int: Example: subscription with publishing interval 1000 ms and sampling interval 250 ms with absolute deadband 0.1: the server samples every 250 ms but notifies only values that change by more than 0.1, reducing traffic.
strings.Si può leggere a richiesta oppure iscriv: You can read on request or subscribe to changes.
strings.Read/Browse su richiesta; Subscription c: Read/Browse on request; Subscription with MonitoredItem (sampling and publishing interval, deadband); unsolicited PubSub.
strings.Lo standard Ethernet industriale ODVA, t: The ODVA industrial Ethernet standard, typical of Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.
strings.CIP (Common Industrial Protocol) su Ethe: CIP (Common Industrial Protocol) over Ethernet/TCP/UDP: explicit messaging (TCP 44818) and implicit I/O (UDP 2222).
strings.Come un'agenzia di corrieri: ogni dispos: Like a courier agency: each device ‘produces’ data and whoever needs it ‘consumes’ it, with fast couriers (UDP) for urgent data and registered mail (TCP) for special requests.
strings.Collegare PLC, I/O, azionamenti e robot: Connect PLCs, I/O, drives and robots over standard Ethernet.
strings.Scambio I/O ciclico (implicit, class 1): Cyclic I/O exchange (implicit, class 1) and explicit services (class 3/UCMM) based on CIP objects; profiles for motion, safety and sync.
strings.Stella con switch (IGMP snooping per il: Star with switches (IGMP snooping for multicast), line (integrated switch), DLR (Device Level Ring) with recovery of the order of ms–tens of ms depending on the implementation.
strings.Originator/Target con connessioni stabil: Originator/Target with connections established via Forward_Open; producer/consumer model (multicast or unicast); also client/server for explicit messages.
Good, but not guaranteed like EtherCAT.
strings.Soft real-time con QoS/DSCP e RPI; CIP S: Soft real-time with QoS/DSCP and RPI; CIP Sync/CIP Motion bring synchronization (PTP) for motion.
strings.RPI tipico 2–100 ms; fino a ~1 ms o meno: Typical RPI 2–100 ms; down to ~1 ms or less for I/O and motion on dedicated devices and controllers (depends on the product).
strings.Standard aperto ODVA, ampia base di prod: Open ODVA standard, wide product base
strings.24 byte: Command, Length, Session Handle: 24 bytes: Command, Length, Session Handle, Status, Sender Context, Options
strings.Tempi ciclo, numero massimo di connessio: Cycle times, maximum number of connections and DLR performance depend on the product; refer to the manufacturer's data.
strings.EtherNet/IP è come un'agenzia di corrier: EtherNet/IP is like a courier agency: each device ‘produces’ data at an agreed pace (RPI) and whoever needs it ‘consumes’ it. For special requests (configuration, diagnostics) a ‘registered letter’ (TCP) is used instead.
strings.È molto diffuso con i PLC Rockwell/Allen: It is very widespread with Rockwell/Allen-Bradley PLCs, especially in North America.
strings.EtherNet/IP usa l'encapsulation (TCP/UDP: EtherNet/IP uses encapsulation (TCP/UDP 44818) for sessions and explicit messages, and UDP 2222 for implicit I/O. The connection is created with Forward_Open (RPI O→T and T→O, sizes, trigger). I/O data carry Connection ID and Sequence Number.
strings.Il multicast richiede IGMP snooping per: Multicast requires IGMP snooping so as not to flood the network. CIP Sync uses IEEE 1588 for synchronization; CIP Motion, CIP Safety and CIP Security extend the profile. DLR allows ring recovery with times that depend on the devices.
strings.Esempio: in uno stabilimento con PLC Log: Example: in a plant with a Logix PLC, 40 I/O modules and a drive, the scanner opens a connection with each one specifying an RPI of 10 ms (and 2 ms for the drive). For redundant rings, a DLR ring with compatible switches is used.
strings.Esempio: un adapter con RPI 5 ms e timeo: Example: an adapter with RPI 5 ms and timeout multiplier ×4: if no frames arrive for 20 ms the connection drops and the PLC signals the loss of the module; with a lower RPI detection is faster but the network load grows.
strings.I dati di I/O arrivano da soli a ritmo f: I/O data arrive on their own at a fixed pace; special messages are requested on demand.
strings.Implicit: producer/consumer ciclico o CO: Implicit: cyclic or COS producer/consumer, unsolicited (RPI); Explicit: request/response (Get_Attribute…).
strings.Il protocollo più semplice e diffuso per: The simplest and most widespread protocol for reading and writing values in instruments and PLCs.
strings.Modbus Application Protocol su TCP/IP (p: Modbus Application Protocol over TCP/IP (port 502) with MBAP header: function codes and 16-bit registers in a client/server model.
strings.Come un armadietto con cassetti numerati: Like a cabinet with numbered drawers: you ask ‘give me the contents of drawers 100 to 103’ or ‘put 25 in drawer 200’. What the drawers mean is explained by the device manual.
strings.Leggere e scrivere valori (registri) di: Read and write values (registers) of meters, inverters, controllers and PLCs in a very simple way.
strings.Accesso a coil e discrete input (1 bit): Access to coils and discrete inputs (1 bit) and input/holding registers (16 bit) through function codes; widely used for meters, inverters, sensors and gateways to Modbus RTU networks.
strings.Ethernet 10/100/1000; la stessa semantic: Ethernet 10/100/1000; the same semantics travel over RS-485 (Modbus RTU) through gateways.
strings.Dipende dall'infrastruttura IP; i gatewa: Depends on the IP infrastructure; gateways use the Unit ID to route towards RTU lines (addresses 1–247, typically 32 stations per RS-485 segment).
A client asks, the server answers.
strings.Client/server (storicamente master/slave: Client/server (historically master/slave): one request, one reply; the Transaction ID allows several requests in flight; maximum PDU 253 bytes.
strings.Non deterministico (TCP); su reti dedica: Non-deterministic (TCP); on dedicated networks it is predictable in practice but without guarantees.
strings.Nessun ciclo: il client interroga quando: No cycle: the client polls when needed (polling).
strings.Polling del client; tipicamente 10–1000: Client polling; typically 10–1000 ms per scan, depending on the number of requests and devices.
strings.Semplicissimo e supportato da quasi ogni: Very simple and supported by almost every device
strings.Nessuna sicurezza nativa (Modbus/TCP Sec: No native security (Modbus/TCP Security with TLS is little used)
strings.Solo polling: niente notifiche né sincro: Polling only: no notifications or synchronization
strings.Registri senza significato: la mappa dip: Registers without meaning: the map depends on the device

strings.Numerazione dei registri (base 0 o base: Register numbering (base 0 or base 1, e.g. 40001) and byte/word order in 32-bit values vary between manufacturers: check the device map.
strings.Modbus TCP è il 'linguaggio di base' deg: Modbus TCP is the ‘basic language’ of instruments: almost every meter, inverter or controller speaks it. The device has a table of numbered registers and the client can read or write them.
strings.Non dice cosa rappresenta un registro: l: It does not say what a register represents: only the manual does. That is why it is very easy to use but not very ‘intelligent’.
strings.Il modello dati è piatto: coil e discret: The data model is flat: coils and discrete inputs at 1 bit, input and holding registers at 16 bits. Each request carries a function code and the start address; the reply repeats the function code or, in case of error, returns it with the high bit (0x80 + FC) plus an exception code.
strings.Sul TCP l'header MBAP sostituisce l'indi: Over TCP the MBAP header replaces the address and CRC of Modbus RTU: Transaction ID to match replies, Protocol ID at 0, Length and Unit ID, useful when a gateway forwards to RS-485.
strings.Esempio: un PC legge ogni secondo la pot: Example: a PC reads the power of an energy meter every second: ‘give me 2 registers starting from 3000’. The two registers form a floating-point number, as explained in the meter manual.
strings.Esempio: lettura di 2 holding register d: Example: reading 2 holding registers from address 3000 (FC 0x03) from a network analyzer: the two 16-bit registers form a 32-bit float; the word order (big/little endian) must be checked in the manual, otherwise the value comes out wrong.
strings.Il client chiede, il dispositivo rispond: The client asks, the device answers.
strings.Il bus a due fili robusto di macchine, v: The robust two-wire bus of machines, vehicles and medical devices.
strings.Livello applicativo CiA 301 su CAN (ISO: CiA 301 application layer over CAN (ISO 11898): Object Dictionary, PDO, SDO, NMT, SYNC, heartbeat and device profiles.
strings.Una riunione dove tutti possono parlare: A meeting where everyone may speak but, if two start together, the one with the more ‘priority’ voice speaks without interrupting anyone. The bus is always listening and urgent messages go first.
strings.Collegare sensori, azionamenti e control: Connect sensors, drives and controllers on a simple, very robust bus.
strings.Applicazione standard (CiA 301) sopra CA: Standard application layer (CiA 301) on top of CAN: Object Dictionary, PDO for process data, SDO for parameters, NMT for states, SYNC/EMCY/heartbeat; profiles CiA 401 (I/O) and 402 (drives).
strings.Cavo a due fili intrecciati con resisten: Twisted two-wire cable with resistors at both ends.
strings.CAN differenziale CAN_H/CAN_L (ISO 11898: Differential CAN_H/CAN_L (ISO 11898-2), 120 Ω termination at both ends; D-Sub 9, M12 and other connectors.
strings.10 kbit/s … 1 Mbit/s (CAN FD con CANopen: 10 kbit/s … 1 Mbit/s (CAN FD with CANopen FD: data phase above 1 Mbit/s)
strings.Bus lineare con derivazioni corte; lungh: Linear bus with short stubs; length tied to the bitrate (≈ 25 m at 1 Mbit/s, ≈ 500 m at 125 kbit/s, ≈ 5 km at 10 kbit/s); up to 127 nodes (Node-ID 1–127).
strings.Tutti possono parlare: vince il messaggi: Everyone can talk: the most important message wins.
strings.Multi-master con arbitraggio CSMA/CR sul: Multi-master with CSMA/CR arbitration on the identifier (lowest ID = highest priority). Producer/consumer for PDOs, client/server for SDOs, NMT master for state management.
strings.Latenza limitata e calcolabile per ogni: Bounded and calculable latency for each priority (CAN schedulability analysis); SYNC for synchronous PDOs. It does not offer the synchronization of EtherCAT or IRT.
strings.SYNC tipico 1–10 ms; un frame da 8 byte: Typical SYNC 1–10 ms; an 8-byte frame at 1 Mbit/s lasts ≈ 110–135 µs (with bit stuffing); the bus load limits the number of PDOs per cycle.
strings.Molto robusto ai disturbi, ideale per ma: Very robust against disturbances, ideal for mobile machines
strings.Cablaggio a bus semplice e componenti ec: Simple bus wiring and inexpensive components
strings.Priorità dei messaggi e rilevazione erro: Message priorities and built-in error detection
strings.Massimo 127 nodi, lunghezza ridotta alle: Maximum 127 nodes, length reduced at high speeds
strings.Sincronizzazione meno precisa di EtherCA: Synchronization less precise than EtherCAT or IRT
strings.Object Dictionary e file EDS/DCF richied: Object Dictionary and EDS/DCF files require expertise
strings.Bitrate, lunghezze massime e supporto a: Bitrate, maximum lengths and CAN FD support (CiA 1301) depend on cable, transceiver and implementation.
strings.CANopen nasce nelle automobili e nelle m: CANopen was born in cars and mobile machines: environments with vibration and interference where the cable must always work. On the same twisted pair all nodes hear everything and take only what concerns them.
strings.Il 'direttore' (master NMT) accende i di: The ‘conductor’ (NMT master) switches the devices on and, if needed, sets the pace with a SYNC message. Then each node transmits its data in its messages (PDOs).
strings.Ogni nodo espone un Object Dictionary: g: Each node exposes an Object Dictionary: SDOs read and write parameters (client/server, slow), PDOs carry process data in frames of max 8 bytes (producer/consumer, fast), NMT governs states (pre-operational, operational, stopped).
strings.L'identificatore a 11 bit combina functi: The 11-bit identifier combines function code and Node-ID: it determines who wins arbitration. With SYNC, synchronous PDOs are sampled together; heartbeat or node guarding detect lost nodes.
strings.Esempio: su un escavatore, la pompa, il: Example: on an excavator, the pump, the joystick and the position sensors share a single two-wire cable. The joystick sends commands with a priority message and the pump answers with pressure, even amid dust and vibration.
strings.Esempio: 20 nodi a 250 kbit/s con SYNC a: Example: 20 nodes at 250 kbit/s with SYNC at 5 ms: an 8-byte frame lasts ≈ 0.5 ms, so at most about ten PDOs fit in the cycle; the bus load (≈ 50 %) must be calculated to guarantee the latencies of lower-priority messages.
strings.I nodi inviano da soli i dati quando cam: Nodes send data on their own when they change or on the SYNC signal; parameters are requested on demand.
strings.PDO a evento/SYNC/cicli (non sollecitati: Event/SYNC/cyclic PDOs (unsolicited) + heartbeat; SDO on request; the transmission type is chosen per PDO.
strings.Il collegamento 'intelligente' per senso: The ‘smart’ connection for simple sensors and actuators, with remote parameters.
strings.Interfaccia punto-punto IEC 61131-9 (SDC: IEC 61131-9 (SDCI) point-to-point interface between IO-Link Master and Device, with cyclic process data and acyclic parameters/diagnostics.
strings.Come un cavetto USB per sensori: collegh: Like a USB cable for sensors: you plug in the sensor, the master recognizes it, reads its ‘card’ and can adjust it or replace it with the same settings.
strings.Collegare sensori e attuatori semplici a: Connect simple sensors and actuators to automation and configure them remotely.
strings.Interfaccia punto-punto (IEC 61131-9, SD: Point-to-point interface (IEC 61131-9, SDCI): cyclic process data, acyclic parameters and diagnostics (ISDU), events; the master integrates into a higher-level fieldbus.
strings.Cavo a 3 o 5 fili non schermato con conn: Unshielded 3- or 5-wire cable with M12 or M8 connector.
strings.3 fili (L+, L−, C/Q), fino a 20 m, non s: 3 wires (L+, L−, C/Q), up to 20 m, unshielded, M12/M8 connectors; port class A (3 pins) and B (auxiliary power).
strings.Punto-punto: un cavo per ogni dispositiv: Point-to-point: one cable per device, star from the master.
strings.Un solo device per porta del master (tip: One device per master port (typically 4–8 ports); masters connect to the fieldbus with its topology (line, star, ring).
strings.Master/device: il master apre ogni scamb: Master/device: the master opens each exchange and the device answers in the same M-sequence.
Yes: the cycle is fixed for each port.
strings.Ciclo per porta deterministico (min cycl: Deterministic cycle per port (min cycle time declared by the device in the IODD); overall latency depends on the fieldbus and the master cycle.
strings.Da frazioni di millisecondo a qualche ms: From fractions of a millisecond to a few ms.
strings.Min cycle time da 400 µs (COM3) a 132,8: Min cycle time from 400 µs (COM3) to 132.8 ms; typically 2–5 ms depending on device and amount of data.
strings.Parametrizzazione e sostituzione automat: Automatic parameterization and replacement of the sensor (Data Storage)
strings.Diagnostica fino all'ultimo sensore: Diagnostics down to the last sensor
strings.Solo punto-punto: serve un master ogni 4: Point-to-point only: one master every 4–8 devices
strings.Dati di processo limitati (fino a 32 byt: Limited process data (up to 32 bytes per direction)
strings.Non è un bus a sé: richiede un fieldbus: Not a bus on its own: requires a higher-level fieldbus
strings.Sensori di prossimità, fotocellule, sens: Proximity sensors, photocells, smart pressure sensors
strings.M-sequence: master (MC, CKT, PDout, OD): M-sequence: master (MC, CKT, PDout, OD) → device (PDin, OD, CKS)
strings.Le versioni V1.0 e V1.1 differiscono (Da: Versions V1.0 and V1.1 differ (Data Storage, extended ISDU): check master/device compatibility. IO-Link Safety and IO-Link Wireless are extensions with their own requirements.
strings.IO-Link porta l'intelligenza fino all'ul: IO-Link brings intelligence down to the last sensor: each sensor has a dedicated cable to a module (the master) and can communicate not only ‘on/off’ but also value, state and parameters.
strings.Quando un sensore si rompe, lo sostituis: When a sensor breaks, you replace it and the master rewrites the old one's settings: no more manual calibration.
strings.Il master avvia la comunicazione con un: The master starts communication with a wake-up pulse, reads identification and parameters (ISDU) in Preoperate and then goes to Operate: from there it exchanges process data at a fixed cycle with each device, with on-request data appended to the same M-sequence.
strings.Il master è un gateway: raccoglie i proc: The master is a gateway: it collects the process data of its ports and exposes them to the PLC via PROFINET, EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP or other fieldbuses. Devices are described with IODD files.
strings.Esempio: una macchina ha 8 sensori di pr: Example: a machine has 8 proximity sensors on an IO-Link module networked to the PLC. From the PLC you change the switching distance of a sensor and, if one fails, the new sensor immediately receives the same settings.
strings.Esempio: a COM2 (38,4 kbit/s) con 2 byte: Example: at COM2 (38.4 kbit/s) with 2 bytes of process data in and out, the minimum cycle is of the order of 2–3 ms; ISDU parameters (e.g. switching threshold) travel on request, without stopping the cyclic exchange.
strings.Il master interroga il sensore a ciclo f: The master polls the sensor at a fixed cycle.
strings.Ciclo del master per porta (M-sequence);: Master cycle per port (M-sequence); device events are signalled with a flag and read by the master.
strings.Il Modbus 'classico' su cavo RS-485: un: The ‘classic’ Modbus over an RS-485 cable: one master polls up to dozens of slaves.
strings.Modbus seriale (RTU) su RS-485/RS-232: m: Serial Modbus (RTU) over RS-485/RS-232: master/slave with frames delimited by a 3.5-character silence and CRC-16.
strings.Come un insegnante che chiama gli studen: Like a teacher calling students by roll number: one at a time answers, the others listen in silence.
strings.Leggere e scrivere registri di strumenti: Read and write registers of instruments, inverters and meters on a simple serial bus.
strings.Stesso modello dati di Modbus TCP (coil,: Same data model as Modbus TCP (coils, discrete inputs, 16-bit registers) on a serial line, with slave address 1–247.
strings.RS-485 a 2 fili half-duplex (o 4 fili),: 2-wire half-duplex RS-485 (or 4-wire), 120 Ω termination at both ends; RS-232 point-to-point only.
strings.9,6 … 115,2 kbit/s tipico (19,2 kbit/s è: 9.6 … 115.2 kbit/s typical (19.2 kbit/s is the default value required by the specification)
strings.Un bus: tutti gli strumenti sullo stesso: One bus: all instruments on the same cable.
strings.Bus lineare; fino a 32 carichi per segme: Linear bus; up to 32 loads per RS-485 segment without repeaters; addresses 1–247 (0 = broadcast); typical length up to 1200 m.

From tens to hundreds of milliseconds.

strings.Supportato da moltissimi strumenti: Supported by a huge number of instruments
strings.Retrofit di impianti con cablaggio RS-48: Retrofit of plants with RS-485 cabling

strings.Immagina una fabbrica con un PLC (il 'ce: Imagine a factory with a PLC (the ‘brain’) and hundreds of sensors and motors. Without a bus, each sensor would have its own cable all the way to the electrical cabinet: kilometres of copper, hours of wiring and great confusion when something breaks.
strings.Un bus di campo (o protocollo industrial: A fieldbus (or industrial protocol) is like a shared road: a single cable runs past all the machines and each gets on and off where needed. The protocol is the traffic rules: who may speak, when, and how the address is written on the parcel.
strings.Esempio pratico: in una linea di imbotti: Practical example: on a bottling line, an optical sensor counts the bottles and a valve fills them. With a bus a few cables are enough: the PLC asks ‘how many bottles?’ and orders ‘open the valve’ on the same line. Every protocol in this app solves the same problem in a different way: some are very fast, others more flexible, others designed for the cloud.
strings.Un bus di campo sostituisce il cablaggio: A fieldbus replaces point-to-point wiring (one cable per I/O) with a shared medium on which the master exchanges process data with the nodes. The fundamental design choices are: medium and physical layer, access method (polling, token, TDMA, passing frame), cycle and determinism, topology and diagnostics.
strings.Esempio pratico: una macchina con 40 I/O: Practical example: a machine with 40 I/Os and 6 drives. With PROFIBUS DP at 1.5 Mbit/s the cycle is calculated by summing request, TSDR and response for each slave (a few ms). With EtherCAT the same plant fits in a single frame and the cycle drops to a few hundred µs; with MQTT/OPC UA, instead, there is no guaranteed cycle but you gain IT integration.
strings.Il confronto utile non è 'quale è il mig: The useful comparison is not ‘which is the best’ but ‘which requirement dominates’: cycle time/synchronism, existing wiring, interoperability, security or cloud connection.
strings.Come chiedere «ci sono novità?» a interv: Like asking “any news?” at regular intervals. Timing is predictable, but you ask even when nothing has changed.
strings.Il richiedente interroga a cadenza fissa: The requester polls at a fixed pace: constant load N/cycle, maximum latency ≈ one cycle + processing, deterministic and calculable behaviour. It wastes bandwidth if data rarely change.
strings.Come un campanello: il dato arriva da so: Like a doorbell: the data arrives on its own only when needed. Little traffic and immediate reaction, but timing is not guaranteed.
strings.Il produttore invia in base a eventi (on: The producer sends based on events (on-change, pub/sub): load proportional to the event rate, minimum latency under normal conditions, but with bursts (everything changes together) load and queues are unpredictable: less deterministic.
strings.Questi protocolli possono fare le due co: These protocols can do both: cyclic for guaranteed timing, notification to save traffic and react immediately.
strings.Qui la scelta del trasferimento decide i: Here the choice of transfer decides the trade-off: cyclic (RPI, sampling interval, PDO cycles) → determinism and constant load; on-change/COV/subscription → performance and bandwidth efficiency, with variable load and latency. They are often combined (cyclic for safety + on-change for events).
strings.Un dato può raggiungere chi lo vuole in: Data can reach whoever wants it in two ways: someone asks for it (polling) or it arrives on its own when it changes (notification). The difference is the trade-off between determinism (guaranteed timing) and performance (less traffic, immediate reaction).
strings.Polling = determinismo e carico costante: Polling = determinism and constant load, with latency up to one cycle and wasted bandwidth if data do not change. Notification = efficiency and minimum latency, with variable load and bursts that break determinism. Hybrid protocols let you choose per variable: cyclic for what requires guaranteed timing, on-change for the rest.

strings.Un dato può raggiungere chi lo vuole in: Data can reach whoever wants it in two ways: someone asks for it (polling) or it arrives on its own when it changes (notification). Polling gives predictable timing only if the network guarantees it too; notification saves traffic, but the load depends on events.
strings.Il polling non è deterministico di per s: Polling is not deterministic by itself: it becomes so only if the cycle is bounded by the medium and the protocol (PROFIBUS, AS-i, IO-Link, EtherCAT: calculable cycle). Over TCP/IP (Modbus TCP, S7) polling is not deterministic: retransmissions and load vary the timing. On-change notification has a load proportional to events and, with bursts, unbounded latency.
strings.Come chiedere «ci sono novità?» a interv: Like asking “any news?” at regular intervals. You ask even when nothing has changed; timing is predictable only if the network guarantees it.
strings.Il richiedente interroga a cadenza fissa: The requester polls at a fixed pace: constant load N/cycle, maximum latency ≈ one cycle + processing. It is deterministic only if the medium is too (serial buses, EtherCAT, calculable cycle); over TCP/IP it is not. It wastes bandwidth if data rarely change.
strings.Read Var/Write Var su richiesta; nessuna: Read Var/Write Var on request; no on-change notification from the client (polling only). Over TCP/IP polling is not deterministic.
strings.Solo polling client→server; nessuna noti: Client→server polling only; no notifications. Over TCP timing is not guaranteed.
strings.nei protocolli ibridi la modalità scelta: in hybrid protocols, the mode chosen for each variable sets the trade-off. Cyclic = constant load and, on a deterministic medium, bounded latency; on-change = better bandwidth and latency on average, but the worst case (all variables change together) is unbounded.
strings.Nessun protocollo è «conforme a CRA o NI: No protocol is “CRA or NIS2 compliant” by itself: these rules concern products, organizations and processes. The protocol matters because it offers (or not) security functions and because it changes the attack surface. This page is educational and not legal advice: always check the official texts, national transpositions and dates.
strings.Il protocollo non determina la conformit: The protocol does not determine compliance: the CRA applies to products with digital elements (manufacturer obligations), NIS2 to essential and important entities (risk-management measures and incident reporting), IEC 62443 to industrial systems and components. The choice of bus affects native functions (authentication, encryption, integrity, access control, audit) and exposure and compensating measures. Educational page, not legal advice: check the official texts, national transposition and application dates.
strings.Regola UE sulla cybersicurezza dei prodo: EU rule on the cybersecurity of products with digital parts (machines, devices, software) sold in Europe: they must be secure by design and updatable.
strings.Regolamento (UE) 2024/2847: requisiti es: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847: essential security requirements (Annex I) for products with digital elements, vulnerability handling across the lifecycle, technical documentation, CE marking and reporting to ENISA/CSIRT of actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents.
strings.Chi fabbrica o importa dispositivi, PLC,: Whoever manufactures or imports devices, PLCs, gateways, software and components.
strings.Fabbricanti, importatori e distributori: Manufacturers, importers and distributors of products with digital elements; end users are not direct addressees but receive its requirements in the products they buy.
strings.In vigore dal 10 dicembre 2024; segnalaz: In force since 10 December 2024; reporting from 11 September 2026; main obligations from 11 December 2027 (check).
strings.Entrata in vigore 10/12/2024; obblighi d: Entry into force 10/12/2024; reporting obligations for exploited vulnerabilities and incidents from 11/09/2026; general application from 11/12/2027. Check delegated acts and harmonised standards.
strings.Un'interfaccia IP senza autenticazione n: An IP interface with no authentication or encryption is hard to justify; a closed bus still requires a documented risk analysis. Secure firmware updates matter.
strings.Impatto sui bus: interfacce esposte (IP,: Impact on buses: exposed interfaces (IP, gateways, web) must offer authentication, integrity/confidentiality protection where proportionate and attack-surface reduction; closed fieldbuses require risk assessment and secure default configuration. The manufacturer is responsible for the product, not only for the protocol.
strings.Direttiva UE che obbliga molte aziende (: EU directive requiring many companies (energy, water, transport, health, critical manufacturing, etc.) to manage cyber risks and report incidents.
strings.Direttiva (UE) 2022/2555: misure di gest: Directive (EU) 2022/2555: risk-management measures (Art. 21: access control, cryptography, supply-chain security, vulnerability handling, business continuity), management-body accountability, reporting of significant incidents (24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification, final report within one month).
strings.Chi gestisce l'impianto: soggetti essenz: Whoever runs the plant: essential and important entities in the covered sectors.
strings.Soggetti essenziali e importanti nei set: Essential and important entities in the sectors of Annexes I and II (including part of manufacturing); in Italy it is transposed by Legislative Decree 138/2024 with the National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) as authority.
strings.Termine di recepimento 17 ottobre 2024;: Transposition deadline 17 October 2024; in Italy in force since 16 October 2024 (check).
strings.Recepimento entro il 17/10/2024; in Ital: Transposition by 17/10/2024; in Italy Legislative Decree 138/2024 in force from 16/10/2024 with obligations phased in by the ACN. Penalties up to €10M or 2 % of turnover (essential) and €7M or 1.4 % (important), per the directive.
strings.Servono segmentazione, accessi remoti co: Segmentation, controlled remote access and an asset inventory are needed: buses without security must be isolated and protected at the boundaries.
strings.Impatto sui bus: i flussi che attraversa: Impact on buses: flows crossing zones or coming from IT/cloud/remote access should use protocols with authentication and encryption (OPC UA, MQTT with TLS, CIP Security, ADS Secure) or be protected by gateways/firewalls and VPN; fieldbuses without security require physical/logical isolation and monitoring.
strings.Lo standard di riferimento per la sicure: The reference standard for industrial automation security: it divides the plant into protected zones and defines security levels for components.
strings.Serie IEC 62443: 2-1 (programma di sicur: IEC 62443 series: 2-1 (security programme), 3-2 (risk assessment, zones and conduits), 3-3 (system requirements), 4-1 (secure development lifecycle), 4-2 (component requirements) with Security Levels SL 1–4 over seven Foundational Requirements: FR1 IAC, FR2 UC, FR3 SI, FR4 DC, FR5 RDF, FR6 TRE, FR7 RA.
strings.Asset owner, integratori di sistema e fo: Asset owners, system integrators and product suppliers; it is the most widely used standard to demonstrate ‘appropriate measures’ for the CRA and NIS2.
strings.Standard IEC/ISA, non ISO. È una serie i: An IEC/ISA standard, not ISO. It is an evolving series: check the current editions.
strings.Standard IEC con ISA; la serie è in evol: IEC standard with ISA; the series is evolving (different editions and parts): check the applicable version. It is often cited as a technical reference for the CRA/NIS2, but it is not automatically a presumption of conformity.
strings.È il filtro tecnico più utile: guarda qu: It is the most useful technical filter: see which security functions the bus offers and at which level (zones and conduits).
strings.Mappatura delle cinque funzioni usate qu: Mapping of the five functions used here: authentication ↔ FR1 (IAC), access control ↔ FR2 (UC), integrity ↔ FR3 (SI), encryption ↔ FR4 (DC), audit/log ↔ FR6 (TRE). Conduits between zones with buses lacking security require gateways/firewalls; OPC UA and CIP Security allow higher SLs to be reached on the channel.
strings.Lo standard ISO per gestire la sicurezza: The ISO standard for managing information security in a company through a management system (ISMS).
strings.ISO/IEC 27001:2022: sistema di gestione: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: risk-based information security management system; Annex A with 93 controls (organizational, people, physical, technological). Controls relevant to networks: A.8.20 network security, A.8.21 network services security, A.8.22 segregation of networks, A.8.24 use of cryptography.
strings.Organizzazioni che vogliono certificare: Organizations that want to certify their security system.
strings.Qualsiasi organizzazione; copre l'IT e,: Any organization; it covers IT and, if included in the scope, OT as well. It is not specific to automation: for OT it is combined with IEC 62443.
strings.Edizione 2022 (transizione dalle certifi: 2022 edition (transition from 2013 certifications ended in 2025, check).
strings.Edizione 2022 con 93 controlli; le certi: 2022 edition with 93 controls; ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certifications had a transition period until October 2025 (check with the certification body).
strings.Aiuta a decidere dove usare protocolli s: It helps decide where to use secure protocols and where to segregate networks with buses lacking security.
strings.Nel trattamento del rischio, i bus senza: In risk treatment, buses without native security are handled with segregation (A.8.22), boundary control (A.8.20/8.21) and cryptography at the perimeter (A.8.24); protocols with TLS/certificates make it easier to demonstrate the controls.
strings.Il nuovo regolamento UE sulle macchine:: The new EU machinery regulation: it requires, among other things, protecting safety controls from tampering.
strings.Regolamento (UE) 2023/1230: requisiti es: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230: essential health and safety requirements, including protection against corruption of safety-related control systems (Annex III, 1.1.9) and safety software; it replaces Directive 2006/42/EC.
strings.Costruttori di macchine e di componenti: Manufacturers of machines and safety components.
strings.Costruttori, importatori e distributori: Manufacturers, importers and distributors of machines and safety components.
strings.Applicazione generale dal 20/01/2027; la: General application from 20/01/2027; Directive 2006/42/EC ceases from that date. Check the harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 13849, IEC 62061) and IEC TR 63074 on safety/security relations.
strings.I bus safety (PROFIsafe, FSoE, CIP Safet: Safety buses (PROFIsafe, FSoE, CIP Safety…) protect against random errors, not attacks: security is needed as well.
strings.Il black channel dei protocolli safety r: The black channel of safety protocols detects random errors (CRC, counters, timeouts) but is not an authentication or confidentiality mechanism: against tampering, security measures for the channel and the system are needed (IEC TR 63074).
strings.Chi parla è davvero chi dice di essere?: Is the one talking really who they claim to be?
strings.Identificazione e autenticazione di disp: Identification and authentication of devices and users (certificates, PSK, passwords).
strings.Chi può fare cosa (leggere, scrivere, co: Who may do what (read, write, configure).
strings.Protezione contro la manomissione dei me: Protection against message tampering (MAC/signature), not just CRC.
strings.Chi ascolta sul cavo non può leggere i d: Whoever listens on the cable cannot read the data.
strings.Riservatezza dei dati in transito (TLS/D: Confidentiality of data in transit (TLS/DTLS, AES).
strings.Registrazione degli eventi e tracciabili: Event recording and traceability (audit events, broker/device logs).
strings.È nato con la sicurezza: certificati, fi: It was born with security: certificates, signing and encryption, users and roles, audit events.
strings.Security Model (Part 2/4/6): SecurityPol: Security Model (Parts 2/4/6): SecurityPolicy and SecurityMode (Sign, SignAndEncrypt), X.509 certificates, user identity, roles (Part 18), audit events; mappable to IEC 62443-4-2 requirements. Beware of deprecated policies (Basic128Rsa15, Basic256) and certificate management.
strings.Usa SignAndEncrypt, disattiva la modalit: Use SignAndEncrypt, disable the None mode, manage the certificates.
strings.Disattivare None e policy deprecate, tru: Disable None and deprecated policies, trust lists and certificate renewal, firewall on 4840, users with minimal roles, collection of audit events.
strings.La sicurezza dipende da TLS e dal broker: Security depends on TLS and the broker: good if configured, otherwise none.
strings.TLS (8883), certificati client, utente/p: TLS (8883), client certificates, username/password, topic ACLs in the broker; MQTT 5 adds enhanced authentication. No end-to-end payload security nor audit in the protocol (broker logs).
strings.Sempre TLS, certificati per client, ACL: Always TLS, client certificates, per-topic ACLs, redundant and protected broker.
strings.TLS 1.2/1.3 obbligatorio, mutual TLS, AC: TLS 1.2/1.3 mandatory, mutual TLS, topic ACLs, rate limiting, broker logs, segmentation and hardening; payload encryption when crossing third-party brokers.
strings.CIP Security aggiunge autenticazione e c: CIP Security adds authentication and encryption, but only on devices that support it.
strings.CIP Security (ODVA): TLS/DTLS, certifica: CIP Security (ODVA): TLS/DTLS, certificates or PSK, security profiles; support is not uniform across devices. Classic EtherNet/IP devices otherwise have no native security.
strings.Abilita CIP Security dove disponibile, s: Enable CIP Security where available, segment and filter with industrial firewalls.
strings.CIP Security sui dispositivi compatibili: CIP Security on compatible devices; VLANs and firewalls with CIP inspection, IGMP snooping, disabling unnecessary web services, passive traffic monitoring.
strings.ADS Secure aggiunge TLS; senza, l'access: ADS Secure adds TLS; without it, access relies on the configured routes.
strings.ADS Secure (TLS con certificati o PSK) n: ADS Secure (TLS with certificates or PSK) in recent TwinCAT versions; classic ADS is protected only by AMS routes and the network. Check version and router settings.
strings.Usa ADS Secure, limita le route e la por: Use ADS Secure, limit the routes and port 48898.
strings.ADS Secure con certificati, route minime: ADS Secure with certificates, minimal routes, firewall on 48898/8016, segmentation of engineering PCs and router logs.
strings.L'S7comm classico è senza sicurezza; i n: Classic S7comm has no security; newer PLCs add firmware-dependent protections.
strings.S7CommPlus (S7-1200/1500) con integrità: S7CommPlus (S7-1200/1500) with integrity and, in recent versions, encrypted communication (TLS); CPU protection levels. Classic S7comm and PUT/GET access lack robust authentication.
strings.Disattiva PUT/GET, usa i livelli di prot: Disable PUT/GET, use protection levels, isolate the networks.
strings.Firmware aggiornato, protezione CPU con: Updated firmware, CPU password protection, PUT/GET disabled, TLS where available, filtering of TCP/102, segmentation and monitoring.
strings.La specifica prevede classi di sicurezza: The specification provides security classes, but few devices implement them: segmented networks are needed.
strings.PROFINET Security (Security Class 1–3 ne: PROFINET Security (Security Class 1–3 in recent specifications): optional authentication, integrity and encryption of traffic; device adoption still limited. RT traffic is L2 and not routable beyond the segment, reducing remote exposure.
strings.Segmenta in zone, proteggi i confini, co: Segment into zones, protect the boundaries, control physical access to ports.
strings.Zone e conduit (IEC 62443-3-2), VLAN, di: Zones and conduits (IEC 62443-3-2), VLANs, disabling unused ports, port security/802.1X on switches, firewall at the IT/OT boundary, SNMP/LLDP monitoring, Security Class where supported.
strings.BACnet/IP classico è senza sicurezza; BA: Classic BACnet/IP has no security; BACnet/SC (TLS) is the secure variant.
strings.BACnet/SC (ASHRAE 135, Addendum bj): con: BACnet/SC (ASHRAE 135, Addendum bj): TLS connections with mutual certificate authentication and hubs; BACnet/IP and MS/TP have no authentication. Migration to SC depends on the products.
strings.Passa a BACnet/SC dove possibile e separ: Move to BACnet/SC where possible and separate the building network from the offices.
strings.BACnet/SC con certificati, BBMD protetti: BACnet/SC with certificates, protected BBMDs, dedicated VLANs, firewall on UDP 47808, device inventory and firmware updates.
strings.KNX Data Secure e IP Secure aggiungono p: KNX Data Secure and IP Secure add protection, but must be enabled device by device.
strings.KNX Data Secure (autenticazione e cifrat: KNX Data Secure (telegram authentication and encryption with AES-128 CCM) and KNX IP Secure for tunnelling/routing over IP; non-Secure devices remain unprotected. Physical access to the TP cable = access to the bus.
strings.Usa componenti Secure e proteggi fisicam: Use Secure components and physically protect the cabling and IP gateways.
strings.Data Secure e IP Secure con chiavi gesti: Data Secure and IP Secure with keys managed in ETS, physical protection of the twisted pair, IP gateways with firewalls, separation from the office network.
strings.Modbus TCP classico non ha né password n: Classic Modbus TCP has neither passwords nor encryption: anyone on the network can read and write.
strings.Nessuna autenticazione, cifratura o inte: No authentication, encryption or integrity in the protocol; Modbus/TCP Security exists (TLS, port 802, certificates with roles) but is rare in devices. Port 502 is often exposed by mistake.
strings.Isolalo in una rete dedicata, usa gatewa: Isolate it in a dedicated network, use gateways/firewalls and a VPN for remote access.
strings.Segmentazione rigorosa, allow-list di cl: Strict segmentation, allow-lists of clients and function codes on deep-packet firewalls, secure gateways (TLS), no Internet exposure, write monitoring.
strings.Nessuna sicurezza nel protocollo: la pro: No security in the protocol: protection is physical and at the gateway.
strings.Nessuna autenticazione, cifratura o inte: No authentication, encryption or integrity beyond error checking. The attack surface is physical access to the cable and the gateways/masters towards IP, not directly routable from the Internet.
strings.Proteggi gli armadi e i cavi e metti un: Protect cabinets and cables and put a firewall where the bus connects to IP networks.
strings.Controllo accessi fisico, gateway/master: Physical access control, hardened gateways/masters and protection of engineering ports, monitoring of anomalous faults, gradual migration to PROFINET with Security.
strings.Nessuna sicurezza nativa: tutto dipende: No native security: everything depends on isolating the segment.
strings.Nessuna autenticazione o cifratura nel p: No authentication or encryption in the protocol; access to a port of the segment allows frame injection. The ETG provides security guidelines. The frame is not routable beyond the L2 segment.
strings.Tieni il segmento dedicato al master e p: Keep the segment dedicated to the master and protect free ports.
strings.Segmento dedicato su NIC separata, maste: Dedicated segment on a separate NIC, hardened master, unused ports disabled or blocked, physical protection of cabinets, Working Counter checking as an anomaly indicator.
strings.Nessuna sicurezza: serve protezione fisi: No security: the cable and gateway need physical protection.
strings.Nessuna autenticazione, cifratura o inte: No authentication, encryption or integrity beyond the CRC; anyone on the bus can act as a master. Remote exposure occurs only through TCP↔RTU gateways.
strings.Isola il bus e controlla i gateway verso: Isolate the bus and control the gateways towards Ethernet.
strings.Protezione fisica, gateway con filtro de: Physical protection, gateways with function-code filtering and allow-lists, no direct remote access, monitoring of timeouts and anomalous replies.
strings.Nessuna sicurezza nativa: chiunque sul b: No native security: anyone on the bus can send messages.
strings.CAN non ha autenticazione né cifratura;: CAN has no authentication or encryption; arbitration rewards priority IDs, so a malicious node can flood the bus. Protection is physical and at gateway level; CANopen Safety is not a security measure.
strings.Proteggi i cablaggi e i gateway CAN↔Ethe: Protect the cabling and the CAN↔Ethernet gateways.
strings.Accesso fisico controllato, gateway con: Controlled physical access, gateways with ID filtering, bus segmentation by function, monitoring of load and unusual IDs, application-level authentication solutions if needed.
strings.Nessuna sicurezza nel protocollo, ma il: No security in the protocol, but the point-to-point link reduces exposure.
strings.Nessuna autenticazione o cifratura; il m: No authentication or encryption; the IO-Link master is the security boundary towards the fieldbus. IO-Link Safety concerns safety, not cybersecurity.
strings.Proteggi il master e i connettori; un se: Protect the master and the connectors; one sensor at a time limits damage.
strings.Master con firmware aggiornato e interfa: Master with updated firmware and protected management interfaces, Data Storage for controlled restore, physical protection, limited access to ISDU parameters.
strings.Nessuna sicurezza nativa: la protezione: No native security: protection is physical.
strings.Nessuna autenticazione o cifratura; il c: No authentication or encryption; the yellow cable is accessible to whoever pierces it. ASIsafe is safety, not security. The gateway is the attack point towards PROFINET/PROFIBUS.
Lock the cabinets and protect the gateway.
strings.Protezione fisica dei cavi e dei moduli,: Physical protection of cables and modules, hardened gateway, controlled address changes, monitoring of new or missing slaves.
strings.Il HART cablato non ha sicurezza; Wirele: Wired HART has no security; WirelessHART encrypts, HART-IP depends on the implementation.
strings.Il 4–20 mA con HART non ha autenticazion: 4–20 mA with HART has no authentication or encryption (whoever accesses the loop can read and reconfigure). WirelessHART uses AES-128 encryption and network keys; HART-IP depends on the product.
strings.Proteggi i modem HART e le cassette di c: Protect HART modems and field junction boxes; limit parameter writes.
strings.Protezione fisica, asset management con: Physical protection, asset management with change control, write protect on instruments, segmentation of HART gateways and multiplexers, WirelessHART with managed keys.
strings.Come leggere la tabella: ● funzione nati: How to read the table: ● native function, ◐ partial or optional (depends on version, device and configuration), ○ absent. The “profile” summarizes how many security functions the protocol offers, not compliance.

Evaluations depend on version, product and configuration; they do not replace an assessment.

strings.Il black channel rileva errori casuali m: The black channel detects random errors but offers neither authentication nor confidentiality
