strings.La serie di standard per la sicurezza de: The series of standards for industrial automation security.
strings.Serie IEC/ISA: zone e conduit, ciclo di: IEC/ISA series: zones and conduits, secure development lifecycle, system and component requirements with Security Levels SL 1–4 over the seven FRs.
strings.Zona = area protetta della rete; conduit: Zone = protected area of the network; conduit = the controlled link between two zones.
strings.Concetto IEC 62443-3-2: raggruppamento d: IEC 62443-3-2 concept: grouping of assets with common security requirements and communication channels between zones to be protected.
strings.Il sistema con cui un'azienda gestisce l: The system by which a company manages information security.
strings.Information Security Management System s: Information Security Management System per ISO/IEC 27001:2022, with 93 controls in Annex A.
strings.Il livello di protezione di un sistema o: The protection level of a system or component, from 1 to 4.
strings.Livello IEC 62443 (SL 1–4) riferito al t: IEC 62443 level (SL 1–4) related to the expected type of attacker; SL-T (target), SL-C (capability) and SL-A (achieved) are distinguished.
strings.Frame da 64 byte a 100 Mbit/s attraverso: 64-byte frame at 100 Mbit/s through one switch; configurable RT cycle (typically 1–4 ms, IRT from 250 µs).
strings.Il cavo verso IO-Device 2 è interrotto:: The cable to IO-Device 2 is broken: the controller no longer receives its data and reports the fault; the other devices keep working.
strings.Il watchdog della IOCR scade dopo DataHo: The IOCR watchdog expires after DataHoldFactor × cycle (typically 3 cycles): the AR is closed, the controller reports “station failure” and periodically retries the connection; the device sets its outputs to substitute values. In an MRP ring the traffic would be redirected the other way round (typical reconfiguration within ~200 ms).
IO-Device 1 is switched off: it no longer answers. The controller notices within a few cycles and informs the program; the rest of the plant keeps running.
strings.Mancano i frame ciclici del device: allo: The device's cyclic frames are missing: when the watchdog (DataHoldFactor × cycle) expires the controller closes the AR, marks the data as invalid (IOPS/IOCS bad), raises the station-failure diagnostics (e.g. OB86 on SIMATIC controllers) and repeats the Connect at intervals.
strings.Un disturbo ha rovinato il messaggio: ch: Noise has damaged the message: the receiver notices from the final check and throws it away. One lost message is not a problem: the next cycle is what counts.
strings.L'FCS (CRC-32) non corrisponde: lo switc: The FCS (CRC-32) does not match: the switch or the network interface drops the frame without retransmitting it. The consumer tolerates missing frames up to DataHoldFactor; the port error counters help to find the faulty cable or connector.
strings.Calcolo a 1,5 Mbit/s (11 bit per caratte: Calculated at 1.5 Mbit/s (11 bits per character) with 4 I/O bytes per slave: the cycle grows with the number of slaves and shrinks with the baud rate.
strings.Il cavo si interrompe prima dello Slave: The cable breaks before Slave 5: that slave no longer answers. On a line bus, however, a break can disturb the others too, because the termination at the end of the cable is missing.
strings.Lo slave oltre l'interruzione non rispon: The slave beyond the break does not answer: the master repeats the request (max_retry_limit), then marks it as missing, keeps polling the others and periodically queries it with Slave_Diag. The section left without termination causes reflections: errors are possible on the slaves still connected too, especially at high baud rates.
strings.Lo Slave 4 è spento: il master lo interr: Slave 4 is switched off: the master polls it, gets no answer and after a few attempts declares it faulty. The other slaves carry on normally.
strings.Nessuna risposta entro lo slot time (TSL: No answer within the slot time (TSL): the master retries up to max_retry_limit, then reports the slave as failed (diagnostics in the master, e.g. OB86) and moves on to the next one. If it is the master that disappears, the slave detects its own watchdog expiring and sets the outputs to the safe state.
strings.Un disturbo ha alterato qualche bit: il: Noise has altered a few bits: the recipient notices from the checks and does not answer; the master repeats the request.
strings.PROFIBUS non usa un CRC ma un FCS (somma: PROFIBUS does not use a CRC but an FCS (sum of the bytes modulo 256), with a parity bit for every character and redundant delimiters (Hamming distance 4). The bad frame is ignored: no answer, the master repeats up to max_retry_limit.
strings.Latenza tipica 5–50 ms per richiesta: di: Typical latency 5–50 ms per request: it depends on the CPU cycle and load and on the network.
strings.Il cavo verso il PLC è staccato: le rich: The cable to the PLC is unplugged: the client's requests get no answer and after a while the program reports “connection lost”.
strings.TCP ritrasmette i segmenti con timeout c: TCP retransmits the segments with growing timeouts; once the (application or keep-alive) timeout expires the connection is closed. The client must repeat the whole sequence: TCP, COTP, Setup Communication. The PLC program keeps running: S7comm does not carry the field I/O.
strings.Il PLC è spento o in riavvio: nessuna ri: The PLC is off or restarting: no answer. The client has to reconnect from scratch when the PLC is available again.
strings.Se la CPU è spenta non arrivano ACK e la: If the CPU is off no ACKs arrive and the connection times out; if the CPU has restarted, the first segment it receives triggers a TCP RST and the client notices at once. In both cases COTP and the PDU size must be renegotiated. A CPU in STOP, on the other hand, still answers read requests.
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene scartato, ma: The damaged message is dropped, but TCP notices and resends it by itself: the application only sees a small delay.
strings.Il frame con FCS Ethernet errato è scart: The frame with a bad Ethernet FCS is dropped by the switch or the network interface; the missing TCP segment is not acknowledged and the sender retransmits it (RTO, typically hundreds of ms). No error at S7 level, only latency: it is one of the reasons why timing is not deterministic.
strings.Frame minimo a 100 Mbit/s (≈ 7 µs) più ≈: Minimum frame at 100 Mbit/s (≈ 7 µs) plus ≈ 1 µs of delay per node; the cycle is set by the master (typically 100 µs–1 ms). The transition to OP takes from tens of ms to seconds.
strings.Il cavo tra Slave 2 e Slave 3 è interrot: The cable between Slave 2 and Slave 3 is broken: the frame turns back at Slave 2 already. The master notices that a slave is missing and reports the error.
strings.La porta di Slave 2 perde il link e l'ES: The port of Slave 2 loses the link and the ESC closes the loop (automatic loopback): the frame returns, but the Working Counter is lower than expected. The master invalidates the data of the affected group and locates the fault by reading the link state (DL Status register). With cable redundancy (ring closed on a second master port) all slaves would remain reachable.
strings.Slave 2 è spento: essendo una catena, an: Slave 2 is off: since this is a chain, Slave 3 behind it is no longer reachable either. Slave 1 closes the loop and sends the frame back.
strings.Slave 1 rileva la perdita del link sulla: Slave 1 detects the loss of link on its outgoing port and loops back: WKC lower than expected, input data of the group invalid. The downstream slaves get no frames: if configured, their process data watchdog expires and sets the outputs to the safe state.
strings.Il frame si è rovinato lungo il percorso: The frame was damaged along the way: the slaves flag it and the master discards the data of that cycle, using those of the next one.
strings.Ogni ESC verifica l'FCS mentre il frame: Every ESC checks the FCS while the frame passes: the one that detects the error increments its counters (RX Error Counter, from 0x0300) and marks the frame, so the following slaves recognise it as already corrupted (Forwarded RX Error). The data are not applied and the master discards the frame; the per-port counters point to the faulty cable section.
strings.Latenze tipiche in rete locale; nessun c: Typical latencies on a local network; no guaranteed cycle: it depends on the TwinCAT task and on the network.
strings.Il collegamento verso il PLC è interrott: The link to the PLC is broken: requests get no answer and notifications no longer arrive.
strings.Le richieste scadono con l'errore di tim: Requests expire with the ADS timeout error (0x745, typically after 5 s); the TCP connection is then closed. The registered notifications are lost: after recovery the client must request the handles again and repeat Add Device Notification.
strings.Il PLC TwinCAT è fermo o in riavvio: il: The TwinCAT PLC is stopped or restarting: the client gets an error instead of data and has to register again when the PLC restarts.
strings.Se il runtime è fermo ma il router AMS r: If the runtime is stopped but the AMS router answers, the request comes back with an ADS error code (e.g. 0x6 target port not found, 0x7 target machine not found); if the machine is off, timeout 0x745. After a restart or a program download the symbol handles are no longer valid and must be requested again.
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene scartato e T: The damaged message is dropped and TCP resends it: the application only notices a delay.
strings.FCS Ethernet errato: frame scartato, TCP: Bad Ethernet FCS: frame dropped, TCP retransmits the segment. ADS has no integrity check of its own and relies on TCP and Ethernet: the only effect is higher latency, which can delay a notification.
strings.Su Internet la latenza è di decine di ms: Over the Internet latency is tens of ms per message (a few ms on a local network). No cycle: messages are sent on events.
strings.Il sensore perde la connessione: il brok: The sensor loses the connection: the broker notices because it no longer receives signs of life and can warn the others with a “last will” message prepared in advance.
strings.Senza pacchetti entro 1,5 × Keep Alive i: With no packets within 1.5 × Keep Alive the broker closes the session and publishes the Last Will (if configured in CONNECT). On recovery the client reconnects; with a persistent session (Clean Session = 0, Session Expiry in v5) the pending QoS 1 and 2 messages are delivered again.
strings.Il broker è fermo: nessuno può più pubbl: The broker is down: nobody can publish or receive any more. It is the weak point of the architecture: that is why plants use redundant brokers.
strings.Il broker è un single point of failure:: The broker is a single point of failure: clients detect the outage from the TCP connection or the missing PINGRESP and retry the connection (usually with backoff). QoS 1/2 messages stay queued on the client for retransmission, QoS 0 ones are lost. High availability (clusters, bridges) is not part of the MQTT standard: it depends on the product.
strings.TCP rimedia da solo ai messaggi rovinati: TCP takes care of damaged messages by itself: they are resent, with a small delay.
strings.Il frame corrotto è scartato a livello E: The corrupted frame is dropped at Ethernet level and TCP retransmits: MQTT sees no errors. QoS is not about bit errors but about messages lost when the connection drops: with QoS 1 the sender retransmits with DUP=1 until it receives the PUBACK (duplicates are possible).
strings.Il periodo è il publishing interval scel: The period is the publishing interval chosen by the client (100 ms here). Opening the secure channel uses asymmetric cryptography: from tens to hundreds of ms depending on the device.
strings.Il collegamento cade: il client non rice: The link drops: the client no longer receives updates and tries to reconnect. If it comes back in time, the server also delivers the data left in the queue.
strings.Il client rileva il guasto dal timeout d: The client detects the fault from request timeouts; the server keeps session and subscription until SessionTimeout and until the subscription lifetime expires (LifetimeCount × PublishingInterval). If the client reopens the SecureChannel and reactivates the session in time, it recovers the queued notifications with Republish; otherwise it must recreate session and subscription.
strings.Il server è fermo: il client lo scopre p: The server is down: the client finds out because no more answers arrive and, when the server restarts, it has to go through the whole access procedure again.
strings.Dopo un riavvio del server sessione e su: After a server restart session and subscription no longer exist: requests get errors such as BadSessionIdInvalid or BadSecureChannelIdInvalid and the client must recreate secure channel, session, subscription and monitored items. For high availability OPC UA defines redundant servers (transparent or non-transparent), if supported by the product.
strings.TCP rispedisce da solo il messaggio rovi: TCP resends the damaged message by itself. In addition, if security is enabled, every message is signed: nobody can alter it unnoticed.
strings.Errore di FCS: ritrasmissione TCP, invis: FCS error: TCP retransmission, invisible to the application. With SecurityMode Sign or SignAndEncrypt every chunk carries a signature: a message altered on purpose (not by noise, already stopped by the lower layers) fails verification and the channel is closed with a security error.
strings.Il ciclo è l'RPI impostato per ogni conn: The cycle is the RPI set for each connection (10 ms here; typically 2–100 ms). I/O frames take tens of µs at 100 Mbit/s.
strings.Il cavo verso Adapter 2 è interrotto: lo: The cable to Adapter 2 is broken: the scanner no longer receives its data and after a few cycles reports the error; Adapter 1 keeps working.
strings.La connessione I/O va in timeout dopo RP: The I/O connection times out after RPI × timeout multiplier (e.g. 4 × RPI): the scanner reports the connection fault (in Logix the module faults, e.g. code 16#0203) and periodically retries the Forward_Open; the adapter sets the outputs to the configured state. In a DLR ring the supervisor would close the path again within a few milliseconds.
strings.Adapter 1 è spento: lo scanner smette di: Adapter 1 is off: the scanner stops receiving its data, reports the module fault and keeps trying to reconnect.
strings.Timeout della connessione implicita (RPI: Timeout of the implicit connection (RPI × timeout multiplier): the scanner closes the connection, reports the fault and repeats the Forward_Open until the adapter comes back. The adapter monitors the timeout too: if it is the scanner that disappears, the outputs go to the configured fault state.
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene scartato; es: The damaged message is dropped; since it is cyclic data it is not resent: the next one is simply awaited.
strings.I dati di I/O viaggiano su UDP: il frame: I/O data travel over UDP: the frame with a bad FCS is dropped and not retransmitted. The consumer notices the gap in the sequence number and uses the next packet; only several consecutive losses, up to the connection timeout, cause a fault. Explicit messages over TCP, on the other hand, are retransmitted.
strings.Il periodo è l'intervallo di polling sce: The period is the polling interval chosen by the client (100 ms here; typically 10–1000 ms). The response time depends on the server.
strings.Il cavo è staccato: il client non riceve: The cable is unplugged: the client gets no answer, waits a while (timeout) and then reports the communication error.
strings.Nessuna risposta: scade il timeout dell': No answer: the client application timeout expires (typically 0.5–2 s, configurable) and the request is repeated or reported as an error. When the TCP connection drops, the client must reopen it on port 502. The protocol defines no watchdog: the safe state of the outputs depends on the device.
strings.Il server è spento: nessuna risposta. At: The server is off: no answer. Note: a device that is on but has a problem answers with an error message (exception) instead.
strings.Server spento: timeout o connessione rif: Server off: timeout or connection refused. A gateway to a serial line is a different case: if the slave behind the gateway does not answer, exception 0x0B (Gateway Target Device Failed to Respond) comes back. Exception 0x04 indicates an internal server failure instead.
strings.TCP rispedisce il messaggio rovinato: il: TCP resends the damaged message: at most the client notices a delay.
strings.Modbus TCP non ha un proprio CRC (a diff: Modbus TCP has no CRC of its own (unlike Modbus RTU): integrity relies on the Ethernet FCS and the TCP checksum. The corrupted frame is dropped and retransmitted by TCP; if the delay exceeds the client timeout, the request fails and is repeated.
strings.Durata dei frame a 1 Mbit/s (≈ 130 µs co: Frame duration at 1 Mbit/s (≈ 130 µs with 8 data bytes and bit stuffing); the cycle is the SYNC period (5 ms here; typically 1–10 ms).
strings.Il cavo si interrompe prima del Nodo 2:: The cable breaks before Node 2: the node disappears from the network and the master notices because it no longer hears its “heartbeat”.
strings.Il nodo isolato non riceve ACK, accumula: The isolated node gets no ACK, accumulates transmit errors and becomes error passive. The master detects the missing heartbeat (heartbeat consumer time) and reacts as configured (e.g. stopping the other nodes). The section left without the 120 Ω termination can disturb the rest of the bus as well.
strings.Il Nodo 1 è spento: non manda più dati n: Node 1 is off: it no longer sends data or its “heartbeat”. The master notices within a preset time and brings the plant to a safe condition.
strings.Mancano TPDO e heartbeat del nodo: allo: TPDOs and heartbeat of the node are missing: when the heartbeat consumer time expires the consumer reports the heartbeat error (EMCY) and reacts as defined by object 0x1029 (Error Behavior) and by the application. The other nodes keep communicating: the CAN bus does not depend on a single node.
strings.Un nodo si accorge che il messaggio è ro: A node notices that the message is damaged and immediately signals it to everyone: the sender repeats it automatically.
strings.Il CRC a 15 bit non corrisponde: il rice: The 15-bit CRC does not match: the receiver transmits an error frame (6 dominant bits), everybody discards the message and the sender retransmits it automatically as soon as the bus is free. The TEC/REC counters grow: above 127 the node becomes error passive, with TEC above 255 it goes bus-off and disconnects.
strings.Stima per COM2 (38,4 kbit/s) con pochi b: Estimate for COM2 (38.4 kbit/s) with a few process data bytes; the minimum cycle is declared by the device (from 400 µs in COM3). The wake-up pulse lasts ≈ 80 µs; an ISDU takes several cycles.
strings.Il cavo del sensore è scollegato: il mas: The sensor cable is disconnected: the master notices at once, because every port is a direct link, and tells the PLC. The other device keeps working.
strings.Dopo alcune M-sequence senza risposta va: After a few M-sequences without a valid answer the master declares communication lost on the port, invalidates the process data (qualifier towards the fieldbus) and retries the wake-up. Since it is a point-to-point link, the fault stays confined to that port.
strings.L'attuatore è guasto o scollegato: il ma: The actuator is faulty or disconnected: the master tells the PLC which port has the problem. When you replace it, the master can reload the parameters into the new device by itself.
strings.Porta in errore (evento di comunicazione: Port in error (communication-lost event); on replacement the master checks Vendor ID and Device ID and, if Data Storage is enabled, automatically rewrites the parameters into the new device (IO-Link from version 1.1).
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene scartato e i: The damaged message is dropped and the master repeats the exchange; if it happens often, the port goes into error.
strings.Ogni M-sequence è protetta da un checksu: Every M-sequence is protected by a 6-bit checksum (in CKT and CKS) in addition to the parity of every UART byte. On error the master repeats the message (up to 2 retries), then considers communication on the port lost.
strings.Calcolo a 19,2 kbit/s (11 bit per caratt: Calculated at 19.2 kbit/s (11 bits per character ≈ 0.57 ms): 8 bytes ≈ 4.6 ms, plus the slave response time and the 3.5-character silence. The full round here takes ≈ 26 ms.
strings.Il cavo si interrompe prima dello Slave: The cable breaks before Slave 2: the master polls it, waits for the answer until the timeout and then moves on. Every slave that does not answer slows the whole round down.
strings.Nessuna risposta: il master attende il r: No answer: the master waits for the response timeout (typically 100 ms–1 s), possibly retries and then goes on with the next slave; every missing slave lengthens the polling cycle by one timeout per attempt. The RS-485 section left without termination (120 Ω) can cause errors on the other slaves as well.
strings.Lo Slave 1 è spento: il master non ottie: Slave 1 is off: the master gets no answer, waits for the timeout and reports it as unreachable. The protocol provides nothing more: it is up to the application to decide what to do.
strings.Timeout sul master a ogni interrogazione: Timeout on the master at every poll of the missing slave. Modbus RTU has no standard heartbeat or watchdog: the safe state of the outputs when it is the master that disappears depends on the device (some offer a configurable communication timeout).
strings.Lo slave si accorge che il messaggio è r: The slave notices that the message is damaged and does not answer at all: the master waits for the timeout and repeats the request.
strings.Il CRC-16 calcolato non corrisponde a qu: The calculated CRC-16 does not match the received one: the slave silently discards the frame (no exception, because the address itself could be wrong). The master times out and retries. Frequent errors point to wiring, termination or grounding to be checked.
strings.Una transazione dura ≈ 150 µs (chiamata: One transaction takes ≈ 150 µs (14-bit call, pause and 7-bit response at ≈ 167 kbit/s): here 3 slaves plus one management call; with 31 slaves the cycle is ≈ 5 ms.
strings.Il cavo giallo si interrompe prima dello: The yellow cable breaks before Slave 3: the slave is left without data and without power too, because they travel on the same cable. The master reports it as missing.
strings.Lo slave non risponde alle chiamate: dop: The slave does not answer the calls: after several consecutive errors (typically 3 cycles) the master removes it from the list of active slaves (LAS) and reports a configuration error; its inputs are cleared in the process image. The rest of the network carries on: AS-i needs no termination.
strings.Lo Slave 2 è guasto: il master se ne acc: Slave 2 is faulty: the master notices within a few milliseconds. On replacement the new slave can automatically get the same address.
strings.Slave rimosso dalla LAS dopo le chiamate: Slave removed from the LAS after the unanswered calls, with a configuration error reported. If automatic addressing is enabled and only one slave is missing, the master assigns the address of the failed one to the replacement (same profile, factory address 0).
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene riconosciuto: The damaged message is recognised and repeated at once by the master, without losing the cycle.
strings.AS-i non usa un CRC: ogni telegramma ha: AS-i does not use a CRC: every telegram has a parity bit and the receiver checks the signal shape (Manchester coding with APM modulation: pulse alternation, pauses, length). The bad telegram is discarded and the master repeats the call; repeated errors are counted for diagnostics.
strings.Il periodo è l'intervallo di polling del: The period is the supervisor polling interval (1 s here; typically from 100 ms to minutes). COV notifications arrive only when the value changes.
strings.Il sensore di sala non è più raggiungibi: The room sensor is no longer reachable: the supervisor receives no updates and, after a while, shows the point as offline.
strings.Le richieste confermate vanno in timeout: Confirmed requests time out (APDU_Timeout, typically 3–10 s) and are repeated Number_Of_APDU_Retries times. Unconfirmed COV notifications are lost without warning: that is why subscriptions have a lifetime and must be renewed, often backed by a slow check poll.
strings.La centralina è spenta: il supervisore n: The controller is off: the supervisor gets no answer and reports the device as offline; the other devices keep controlling on their own.
strings.Timeout e ripetizioni dell'APDU, poi il: APDU timeout and retries, then the device is marked offline on the supervisor. On restart the controller can announce itself with I-Am; non-persistent COV subscriptions must be recreated by the client.
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene scartato. Le: The damaged message is dropped. Important requests are repeated after a wait; simple notifications, on the other hand, are lost.
strings.BACnet/IP usa UDP: il datagramma corrott: BACnet/IP uses UDP: the corrupted datagram (Ethernet FCS or UDP checksum) is dropped with no retransmission at transport level. For confirmed services BACnet itself retransmits when APDU_Timeout expires; unconfirmed services (Who-Is, unconfirmed COV) are lost.
strings.A 9600 bit/s (KNX TP1) un telegramma con: At 9600 bit/s (KNX TP1) a telegram with 1 data byte lasts ≈ 12 ms, plus waits and ACK (≈ 20 ms in total). No cycle: telegrams are sent on events.
strings.Il tratto verso il dimmer è interrotto:: The section to the dimmer is broken: the dimmer no longer receives commands (nor the bus power). The other devices keep working, because there is no central “boss”.
strings.I dispositivi oltre l'interruzione perdo: The devices beyond the break lose data and bus voltage (≈ 30 V DC on the same pair). There is no master to notify: if no recipient of the group acknowledges, the sender repeats the telegram (up to 3 times). KNX TP needs no termination, so the rest of the line is not disturbed.
strings.L'attuatore della lampada è guasto: il c: The lamp actuator is faulty: the command is sent anyway and the other devices of the group execute it. Nobody, however, reports by itself that a device is missing.
strings.L'ACK di livello 2 è cumulativo: basta c: The layer-2 ACK is cumulative: one recipient of the group answering is enough for the sender to consider the telegram delivered, so a missing actuator goes unnoticed. Detecting it requires status (feedback) objects or cyclic monitoring implemented at application level.
strings.Chi riceve il messaggio rovinato rispond: Whoever receives the damaged message answers “I did not understand” and the sender repeats it, up to three times.
strings.KNX TP1 non usa un CRC: ogni carattere h: KNX TP1 does not use a CRC: every character has a parity bit and the telegram ends with a checksum byte (cross parity). The recipient that detects the error answers NACK (0x0C) and the sender repeats the telegram, up to 3 times, with the repeat flag set.
strings.A 1200 bit/s ogni byte dura ≈ 9 ms (11 b: At 1200 bit/s every byte lasts ≈ 9 ms (11 bits): a complete transaction takes 300–500 ms. The 4–20 mA signal is continuous and has no transmission time.
strings.L'anello è interrotto: la corrente scend: The loop is broken: the current drops to zero. The PLC notices at once, because a valid signal never goes below 4 mA.
strings.Con l'anello aperto la corrente va a 0 m: With the loop open the current goes to 0 mA: the analog input detects the wire break (value below 3.6 mA, NAMUR NE 43 thresholds) and HART communication stops as well; the master times out and retries. This is the advantage of the 4–20 mA “live zero”.
strings.Il trasmettitore è guasto: porta la corr: The transmitter is faulty: it drives the current to an out-of-range alarm value, so the PLC understands that the measurement is not valid even without digital communication.
strings.In caso di guasto interno il trasmettito: On an internal failure the transmitter forces the alarm current (≤ 3.6 mA or ≥ 21 mA according to NAMUR NE 43, configurable). If it still answers via HART, the device status in the response code (e.g. the “device malfunction” bit) and command 48 provide detailed diagnostics.
strings.Il messaggio rovinato viene scartato e i: The damaged message is dropped and the master repeats the question. The 4–20 mA measurement is not affected: it keeps arriving in analog form.
strings.HART non usa un CRC: parità dispari su o: HART does not use a CRC: odd parity on every byte and one checksum byte (longitudinal XOR). A slave that receives a bad frame reports it in the first byte of the response code (communication errors: parity, overrun, checksum) or does not answer; the master retries. The analog value remains valid.
strings.Il ciclo è l'RPI del produced tag (qui 2: The cycle is the RPI of the produced tag (20 ms here; typically 2–100 ms). Explicit messages have no guaranteed rate.
strings.PLC B non riceve più i dati di PLC A: do: PLC B no longer receives the data from PLC A: after a few cycles it reports that the link is down and the program can react. The HMI keeps reading normally.
strings.Il consumed tag non riceve pacchetti ent: The consumed tag receives no packets within RPI × timeout multiplier: the connection times out and the tag faults (detectable through the CONNECTION_STATUS member, if the data type includes it, or with GSV). The consumer periodically retries the Forward_Open.
strings.PLC A è spento: nessun dato prodotto e n: PLC A is off: no produced data and no answer to the HMI. PLC B detects the loss of the link, the HMI shows a communication error.
strings.Il consumatore va in timeout sulla conne: The consumer times out on the connection (RPI × timeout multiplier) and marks the tag as faulted; the HMI's explicit messages fail by timeout or because the TCP connection is closed. When the producer comes back the consumer reopens the connection with Forward_Open.
strings.Il pacchetto rovinato viene scartato e n: The damaged packet is dropped and not repeated: the one of the next cycle will arrive.
strings.Produced tag su UDP: il frame con FCS er: Produced tags over UDP: the frame with a bad FCS is dropped, with no retransmission; the consumer detects the gap in the sequence number and waits for the next packet. Explicit messages (Read Tag) travel over TCP and are retransmitted.
strings.Write: IndexGroup/Offset (o handle) + da: Write: IndexGroup/Offset (or handle) + data. Reply with Result (ADS error codes, e.g. 0x6 target port not found).
strings.Tempi indicativi (ordine di grandezza):: Indicative times (order of magnitude): they depend on speed, configuration and implementation.
strings.Clicca su un campo per vedere il signifi: Click a field to see its meaning: during the animation the fields light up while the packet travels.
This step is not affected by the fault.
strings.Il messaggio di questo passo non arriva: The message of this step does not reach its destination.
strings.Il nodo guasto non trasmette: questo mes: The failed node does not transmit: this message is not sent.
strings.Il frame arriva alterato e viene scartat: The frame arrives altered and is discarded by the receiver.
strings.Il cavo è interrotto: i messaggi che dev: The cable is broken: the messages that have to pass through it no longer arrive.
strings.Collegamento fisico interrotto: i nodi o: Physical link broken: the nodes beyond the fault are no longer reachable and the protocol timeouts report the error.
strings.Un dispositivo è spento o guasto: non ri: A device is off or faulty: it no longer receives or answers.
strings.Nodo assente: le richieste restano senza: Node missing: requests get no answer until the timeout; the behaviour depends on the protocol and on the configuration.
strings.Un disturbo ha rovinato il messaggio: ch: Noise has damaged the message: the receiver notices and discards it.
strings.Il controllo di integrità del frame non: The frame integrity check does not match: the receiver discards the frame; repetition depends on the protocol.
strings.Il modo in cui i nodi sono collegati dec: The way the nodes are connected decides what happens when a cable breaks or a device switches off. Click a cable to break it or a device to switch it off, and see who remains reachable from the master.
strings.La topologia determina propagazione dei: The topology determines fault propagation, delays and wiring rules. Click a cable to break it or a node to switch it off: the drawing shows the nodes still reachable from the master and the typical effect on the protocol.
strings.Per i protocolli basati su TCP/IP (S7, A: For TCP/IP-based protocols (S7, ADS, MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus TCP, BACnet/IP) the topology is that of the underlying Ethernet network: redundancy is up to the switches, not the protocol.
strings.Bus: dorsale con derivazioni e terminato: Bus: trunk with drops and terminators
strings.Un unico cavo passa da tutti i dispositi: A single cable runs past all the devices, like a road with many houses. At both ends there are terminators, which “absorb” the signal and prevent echoes.
strings.Dorsale condivisa (RS-485, CAN) con deri: Shared trunk (RS-485, CAN) with short drops: all nodes are in parallel on the same medium. Both ends must be closed on the characteristic impedance of the cable (e.g. 120 Ω for CAN; for PROFIBUS a powered resistor network with biasing) to avoid reflections; maximum length and speed are tied to each other.
strings.La dorsale è interrotta: i dispositivi o: The trunk is broken: the devices beyond the cut are isolated. In addition, each of the two sections is left without a terminator: even those still connected may get communication errors.
strings.Rottura della dorsale: i nodi a valle so: Trunk break: the downstream nodes are unreachable and each section has only one termination. Reflections at the open end degrade the signal on the section still connected to the master too, the more so the higher the baud rate.
strings.Si è staccata solo la derivazione di un: Only the drop of one device has come off: the others keep communicating normally.
strings.Derivazione interrotta: è isolato solo q: Drop broken: only that node is isolated, the trunk and its terminations stay intact. A long open stub can still cause reflections: that is why drops must be short (or absent at high baud rates, as in PROFIBUS at 12 Mbit/s).
strings.Un dispositivo spento non blocca gli alt: A switched-off device does not block the others: on the bus they are all connected in parallel.
strings.Un nodo spento o rimosso non interrompe: A node that is off or removed does not interrupt the bus (parallel connection), provided the trunk remains continuous. Mind the active PROFIBUS termination, powered by the last station: if that station is off, the termination does not work properly. A faulty node that transmits continuously (“babbling idiot”), on the other hand, can block the whole segment.
strings.Cablaggio semplice ed economico: un solo: Simple, cheap wiring: a single cable
strings.Aggiungere un nodo richiede poco cavo: Adding a node takes little cable
strings.Un guasto sulla dorsale coinvolge molti: A fault on the trunk affects many nodes
strings.Terminazioni e lunghezze vanno rispettat: Terminations and lengths must be carefully respected
strings.Trovare il punto di guasto è meno immedi: Finding the fault location is less immediate
strings.I dispositivi sono collegati in fila, un: The devices are connected in a row, one after another: each has two ports, one in and one out. No separate switch is needed.
strings.Ogni dispositivo integra uno switch a 2: Every device integrates a 2-port switch (or, in EtherCAT, processes the frame on the fly and forwards it): the wiring follows the machine with no external switches. Every section is a point-to-point link without terminators and every node adds a forwarding delay.
strings.Il cavo è interrotto: tutti i dispositiv: The cable is broken: all the devices after the cut are isolated, even though they work perfectly.
strings.Tutti i nodi a valle del guasto perdono: All the nodes downstream of the fault lose communication: their watchdogs expire and the outputs go to the safe state. The master locates the point from the last reachable node (port diagnostics and LLDP; in EtherCAT link state and Working Counter). Closing the line into a ring tolerates a single fault.
strings.Un dispositivo spento interrompe la cate: A switched-off device interrupts the chain: those after it no longer receive anything either.
strings.Un nodo spento non inoltra più i frame:: A node that is off no longer forwards frames: it is equivalent to a broken cable at that point. Replacing a device without stopping the downstream ones requires a ring or star topology.
strings.Poco cavo e nessuno switch esterno: Little cable and no external switch
strings.Segue la disposizione della macchina: Follows the layout of the machine
strings.Un guasto isola tutti i nodi a valle: A fault isolates all downstream nodes
strings.Il ritardo cresce con il numero di nodi: The delay grows with the number of cascaded nodes
strings.Ogni dispositivo ha il proprio cavo vers: Every device has its own cable to a central switch, like the spokes of a wheel.
strings.Collegamenti punto-punto verso uno switc: Point-to-point links to a switch (or to a multi-port master, as in IO-Link): every section is independent and full duplex. The switch, however, is a single point of failure and every node needs a cable all the way to the centre.
strings.Si è rotto un solo raggio: resta isolato: Only one spoke has broken: just that device is isolated, all the others keep working. If the master's cable breaks instead, everything stops.
strings.Il guasto resta confinato al ramo: gli a: The fault stays confined to the branch: the other nodes are not affected and the port diagnostics of the switch immediately show the link that went down. If the cable between master and switch breaks, on the other hand, all communication is lost.
strings.Un dispositivo spento non disturba gli a: A switched-off device does not disturb the others. But if the switch in the centre goes off, everything stops.
strings.Un nodo terminale spento isola solo se s: An end node that is off isolates only itself and can be hot-swapped. The switch is the single point of failure: that is why industrial switches with redundant power supply or redundant topologies are used.
strings.Un guasto su un ramo non tocca gli altri: A fault on one branch does not affect the others
strings.Più cavo: un tratto per ogni nodo: More cable: one run per node
strings.Lo switch centrale è un punto singolo di: The central switch is a single point of failure
strings.È una stella di stelle: uno switch princ: It is a star of stars: a main switch connects other switches, and the devices of one area branch off from each.
strings.Struttura gerarchica di switch (o di rip: Hierarchical structure of switches (or of repeaters and couplers on serial buses), suited to large plants divided into areas. The uplinks between switches carry the traffic of the whole branch and every cascaded switch adds latency.
strings.Si isola tutto il ramo che sta sotto il: The whole branch below the broken cable is isolated: the closer the fault is to the master, the more devices are cut off.
strings.La rottura di un uplink isola l'intero s: A broken uplink isolates the whole subtree; a broken end branch isolates a single node. The uplinks are therefore the critical links: they are often made redundant with a ring between the switches (MRP, RSTP).
strings.Se si spegne uno switch, perdono il coll: If a switch goes off, all the devices connected to it lose the link.
strings.Uno switch guasto isola tutto il suo sot: A failed switch isolates its whole subtree; an end device only itself. The depth of the tree must be limited: every store-and-forward switch adds delay and jitter (relevant for PROFINET RT; IRT and EtherCAT have their own rules).
strings.Si adatta a impianti grandi e divisi in: Suits large plants divided into areas
strings.I guasti sui rami terminali restano loca: Faults on end branches stay local
strings.Un guasto vicino alla radice isola molti: A fault near the root isolates many nodes
strings.Più switch in cascata: più latenza e più: More cascaded switches: more latency and cost
strings.I dispositivi formano un cerchio chiuso:: The devices form a closed circle: data can arrive from two sides. If a cable breaks, the network reorganises itself and keeps working.
strings.Linea richiusa su se stessa con un proto: A line closed on itself with a redundancy protocol: one node (manager or supervisor) keeps one of its two ring ports blocked, so that no Ethernet loop is created. At the first fault the port is unblocked and the ring becomes a line with all nodes reachable. It tolerates only one fault at a time.
strings.Con due guasti l'anello si divide: i dis: With two faults the ring splits: the devices between the two points stay isolated until you repair at least one.
strings.L'anello tollera un solo guasto: con due: The ring tolerates a single fault: with two breaks the nodes between the two points are isolated until at least one section is repaired.
strings.Un dispositivo spento vale come un tagli: A switched-off device counts as a cut in the ring: the others remain reachable from the other side.
strings.Un nodo spento interrompe l'anello in qu: A node that is off interrupts the ring at that point: the manager unblocks the port and the other nodes remain reachable; only the failed node is lost. This is what makes it possible to replace a device without stopping the line.
strings.Sopravvive a un guasto singolo di cavo o: Survives a single cable or node fault
strings.Poco cavo in più rispetto alla linea: Little extra cable compared with the line
strings.Servono un manager e dispositivi che sup: A manager and devices that support the protocol are needed
strings.Il ripristino non è istantaneo (salvo so: Recovery is not instantaneous (except with dedicated solutions)
strings.Altre soluzioni: EtherCAT chiude l'anell: Other solutions: EtherCAT closes the ring on a second master port (cable redundancy); HSR and PRP (IEC 62439-3) duplicate the frames and have no recovery time; RSTP is slower (from hundreds of ms to seconds) and poorly suited to real-time I/O.
strings.≤ 200 ms nel profilo tipico (esistono pr: ≤ 200 ms in the typical profile (500, 30 and 10 ms profiles exist)
strings.Anello chiuso. Il manager tiene bloccata: Ring closed. The manager keeps one of its two ports blocked and circulates small test messages to check that the ring is intact.
strings.Stato Ring Closed: l'MRM mantiene una po: Ring Closed state: the MRM keeps one ring port Blocked (only MRP frames pass) and sends MRP_Test on both ports at regular intervals (typically 20 ms in the 200 ms profile), receiving them on the other port.
strings.Guasto! I messaggi di prova non tornano: Fault! The test messages no longer return to the manager, and the devices next to the fault notify it.
strings.I client (MRC) adiacenti rilevano il lin: The adjacent clients (MRC) detect the link down and send MRP_LinkChange to the manager; in any case the MRM notices after a few MRP_Test frames are not received. Until reconfiguration the nodes beyond the fault are not reachable.
strings.Il manager apre la porta che teneva chiu: The manager opens the port it kept closed and tells everyone that the route has changed.
strings.L'MRM porta la porta bloccata in Forward: The MRM sets the blocked port to Forwarding and sends MRP_TopologyChange: the nodes clear their address tables (FDB) to relearn the new paths.
strings.La rete funziona di nuovo: i dati raggiu: The network works again: data reach everyone by going the other way round. The interruption lasted a fraction of a second.
strings.Stato Ring Open: tutti i nodi raggiungib: Ring Open state: all nodes reachable on two lines. Recovery within 200 ms in the typical profile: with shorter PROFINET watchdogs (e.g. 3 × 2 ms) some stations still fail and reconnect; bumpless recovery requires MRPD (with IRT) or system redundancy.
strings.Guasto riparato: i messaggi di prova ric: Fault repaired: the test messages go all the way round again.
strings.Il link torna attivo, ma le porte dei cl: The link comes back up, but the ports of the adjacent clients initially stay blocked for data traffic; the MRM again receives its own MRP_Test frames on the other port.
strings.Il manager richiude la sua porta: l'anel: The manager closes its port again: the ring is ready to face a fault once more.
strings.L'MRM riporta la propria porta in Blocke: The MRM sets its port back to Blocked and sends MRP_TopologyChange; the clients set the repaired ports to Forwarding: Ring Closed again, with no temporary loops.
strings.≈ 3 ms per anelli fino a 50 nodi (beacon: ≈ 3 ms for rings of up to 50 nodes (beacon every 400 µs)
strings.Anello chiuso. Il supervisor blocca una: Ring closed. The supervisor blocks one of its ports and continuously sends very short signals (beacons) in both directions.
strings.Stato Normal: il Ring Supervisor attivo: Normal state: the active Ring Supervisor blocks one port (only DLR frames pass) and transmits Beacons on both ports every 400 µs (default value), plus Announce frames for non-beacon-based nodes.
strings.Guasto! I beacon non completano più il g: Fault! The beacons no longer complete the round: the supervisor notices within a couple of milliseconds.
strings.I nodi adiacenti al guasto inviano Link_: The nodes adjacent to the fault send Link_Status to the supervisor; in any case the supervisor detects the loss of beacons within the beacon timeout (1.96 ms by default).
strings.Il supervisor apre la porta bloccata e a: The supervisor opens the blocked port and tells everyone that the route has changed.
strings.Il supervisor passa in Fault State, sblo: The supervisor enters Fault State, unblocks the port and signals the new state with Beacon and Announce frames: the nodes flush their MAC address learning tables.
strings.Tutto funziona di nuovo in pochi millise: Everything works again within a few milliseconds: usually the machines do not even notice the fault.
strings.Ripristino tipico entro ≈ 3 ms per anell: Typical recovery within ≈ 3 ms for rings of up to 50 nodes: less than the timeout of the I/O connections (at least 4 × RPI), which therefore do not drop. The supervisor locates the faulty section (Neighbor_Check, Sign_On) and exposes it to diagnostics.
strings.Guasto riparato: i beacon tornano a fare: Fault repaired: the beacons go all the way round again.
strings.Il supervisor riceve di nuovo i propri b: The supervisor again receives its own beacons on the other port: the ring is physically closed again.
strings.Il supervisor richiude la sua porta: ane: The supervisor closes its port again: the ring is protected once more.
strings.Il supervisor torna in Normal State, blo: The supervisor returns to Normal State, blocks the port again and announces it with the beacons; the nodes flush their tables once more. With several supervisors configured, the one with the highest precedence is active and the others act as backups.
strings.Tutto funziona: clicca su un cavo o su u: Everything works: click a cable or a device to simulate a fault.

strings.Clicca su un protocollo per aggiungerlo: Click a protocol to add it to or remove it from the charts. Performance = average of the cycle and speed scores.

Determinism: real-time class (hard 5, deterministic 4, soft 2.5, none 1). Security: native or partial cybersecurity functions from the Regulations page. Speed: typical bit rate of the medium, on a logarithmic scale (for TCP/IP-based protocols it depends on the network). Topologies: how many of the 5 topologies are supported. Real values depend on version, devices and configuration.

strings.Veloce ma senza garanzie: dati, supervis: Fast but with no guarantees: data, supervision, IT
